AnimatedContent.distance: Distance (in pixels) the component moves during animation.
AnimatedContent.reverse: Whether the animation moves in the reverse direction.
AnimatedContent.duration: Duration of the animation in seconds.
AnimatedContent.ease: GSAP easing function for the animation.
AnimatedContent.animateOpacity: Whether to animate opacity during transition.

Antigravity.waveAmplitude: Intensity of the wave (0 for perfect circle)
Antigravity.lerpSpeed: How fast particles move to the ring
Antigravity.particleShape: Shape of the particles (capsule, sphere, box, tetrahedron)

BlobCursor.sizes: Sizes (px) of each blob. Length must be ≥ trailCount.
BlobCursor.innerSizes: Sizes (px) of inner dots. Length must be ≥ trailCount.
BlobCursor.innerColor: Background color of the inner dot.
BlobCursor.opacities: Opacity of each blob. Length ≥ trailCount.
BlobCursor.filterId: Optional custom filter ID (for multiple instances).
BlobCursor.fastDuration: GSAP duration for the lead blob.
BlobCursor.slowDuration: GSAP duration for the following blobs.
BlobCursor.fastEase: GSAP ease for the lead blob.
BlobCursor.slowEase: GSAP ease for the following blobs.
BlobCursor.zIndex: CSS z-index of the whole component.

ClickSpark.sparkRadius: Distance sparks travel from the click center.
ClickSpark.sparkCount: Number of spark lines per click.
ClickSpark.extraScale: Scale multiplier for spark distance and size.

Crosshair.containerRef: Optional container ref to limit crosshair to specific element. If null, crosshair will be active on entire viewport.

Cubes.gridSize: The size of the grid (number of cubes per row/column)
Cubes.cubeSize: Fixed size of each cube in pixels. If not provided, cubes will be responsive
Cubes.maxAngle: Maximum rotation angle for the tilt effect in degrees
Cubes.radius: Radius of the tilt effect (how many cubes around the cursor are affected)
Cubes.easing: GSAP easing function for the tilt animation
Cubes.duration: Animation duration for enter and leave effects
Cubes.cellGap: Gap between cubes. Can be a number or object with row/col properties
Cubes.borderStyle: CSS border style for cube faces
Cubes.shadow: Shadow effect for cubes. Can be boolean or custom CSS shadow
Cubes.autoAnimate: Whether to automatically animate when user is idle
Cubes.rippleOnClick: Whether to show ripple effect on click
Cubes.rippleSpeed: Speed multiplier for the ripple animation

ElectricBorder.color: Stroke/glow color. Any CSS color (hex, rgb, hsl).
ElectricBorder.chaos: Distortion intensity (0 = no distortion, higher = more chaotic).
ElectricBorder.borderRadius: Border radius in pixels for the electric border path.
ElectricBorder.className: Optional className applied to the root wrapper.
ElectricBorder.children: Content rendered inside the bordered container.

FadeContent.blur: Whether to also animate a 10px blur on entrance.
FadeContent.duration: Animation duration; values >10 are treated as ms, otherwise seconds.
FadeContent.delay: Delay before animation starts; values >10 treated as ms.
FadeContent.disappearAfter: If >0, fades back out after this duration once entrance completes.
FadeContent.disappearEase: GSAP easing for the disappear tween.
FadeContent.onComplete: Fires when the entrance animation completes.
FadeContent.onDisappearanceComplete: Fires when the optional disappear animation completes.
FadeContent.container: Optional scroller (selector or element) for ScrollTrigger.

GhostCursor.className: Additional CSS class names for the container.
GhostCursor.style: Inline styles for the container element.
GhostCursor.trailLength: Number of points stored for the cursor trail (longer = longer smear).
GhostCursor.inertia: Velocity retention when the pointer stops. Higher values make the cursor glide longer.
GhostCursor.grainIntensity: Strength of the film grain post-processing pass.
GhostCursor.bloomRadius: UnrealBloom radius controlling spread of glow.
GhostCursor.bloomThreshold: UnrealBloom threshold; lower includes more pixels in bloom.
GhostCursor.brightness: Final brightness multiplier applied to the effect color.
GhostCursor.color: Base color of the ghost cursor effect.
GhostCursor.mixBlendMode: Blend mode used when compositing with page content.
GhostCursor.edgeIntensity: Darkening near edges of the canvas. 0 = none, 1 = strongest.
GhostCursor.maxDevicePixelRatio: Upper cap for devicePixelRatio to control render cost on high-DPR displays.
GhostCursor.targetPixels: Pixel budget. Resolution is dynamically scaled to keep total pixel count under this budget.
GhostCursor.fadeDelayMs: Idle delay before the trail starts to fade after pointer leaves/stops.
GhostCursor.fadeDurationMs: Duration of the trail fade-out once the delay has elapsed.
GhostCursor.zIndex: z-index applied to the canvas for layering above/below content.

GlareHover.width: The width of the hover element.
GlareHover.height: The height of the hover element.
GlareHover.background: The background color of the element.
GlareHover.borderRadius: The border radius of the element.
GlareHover.borderColor: The border color of the element.
GlareHover.glareColor: The color of the glare effect (hex format).
GlareHover.glareOpacity: The opacity of the glare effect (0-1).
GlareHover.glareAngle: The angle of the glare effect in degrees.
GlareHover.glareSize: The size of the glare effect as a percentage (e.g. 250 = 250%).
GlareHover.transitionDuration: The duration of the transition in milliseconds.

GradualBlur.position: Edge to attach the blur overlay.
GradualBlur.strength: Base blur strength multiplier (affects each layer).
GradualBlur.width: Custom width (optional). Defaults to 100% for vertical positions or matches height for horizontal positions.
GradualBlur.divCount: Number of stacked blur layers (higher = smoother gradient).
GradualBlur.exponential: Use exponential progression for stronger end blur.
GradualBlur.curve: Distribution curve applied to layer progression.
GradualBlur.opacity: Opacity applied to each blur layer.
GradualBlur.animated: Fade in (true) or reveal on scroll ("scroll").
GradualBlur.hoverIntensity: Multiplier applied to strength while hovered.
GradualBlur.target: Position relative to parent container or the entire page (fixed).
GradualBlur.onAnimationComplete: Callback fired after animated reveal completes.
GradualBlur.className: Additional class names appended to root element.
GradualBlur.style: Inline style overrides merged into container style.

ImageTrail.items: An array of image URLs which will be animated in the trail.
ImageTrail.variant: A number from 1 to 8 - all different animation styles.

LaserFlow.horizontalBeamOffset: Horizontal offset of the beam (0-1 of canvas width).
LaserFlow.verticalBeamOffset: Vertical offset of the beam (0-1 of canvas height).
LaserFlow.horizontalSizing: Horizontal sizing factor of the beam footprint.
LaserFlow.verticalSizing: Vertical sizing factor of the beam footprint.
LaserFlow.flowSpeed: Speed of the beam’s flow modulation.
LaserFlow.flowStrength: Strength of the beam’s flow modulation.
LaserFlow.fogScale: Spatial scale for the fog noise.
LaserFlow.fogFallSpeed: Drift speed for the fog field.
LaserFlow.mouseTiltStrength: How much mouse x tilts the fog volume.
LaserFlow.decay: Beam decay shaping for sampling envelope.
LaserFlow.falloffStart: Falloff start radius used in inverse-square blending.
LaserFlow.dpr: Device pixel ratio override (defaults to window.devicePixelRatio).

LogoLoop.logos: Array of logo items to display. Each item can be either a React node or an image src.
LogoLoop.speed: Animation speed in pixels per second. Positive values move based on direction, negative values reverse direction.
LogoLoop.direction: Direction of the logo animation loop. Supports horizontal (left/right) and vertical (up/down) scrolling.
LogoLoop.width: Width of the logo loop container.
LogoLoop.logoHeight: Height of the logos in pixels.
LogoLoop.hoverSpeed: Speed when hovering over the component. Set to 0 to pause, or a lower value for deceleration effect.
LogoLoop.fadeOut: Whether to apply fade-out effect at the edges of the container.
LogoLoop.fadeOutColor: Color used for the fade-out effect. Only applies when fadeOut is true.
LogoLoop.scaleOnHover: Whether to scale logos on hover.
LogoLoop.renderItem: Custom render function for each logo item. Allows full control over item rendering for animations, tooltips, etc.
LogoLoop.ariaLabel: Accessibility label for the logo loop component.
LogoLoop.className: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.
LogoLoop.style: Inline styles to apply to the root element.

MagicRings.colorTwo: Second color — rings interpolate from color to colorTwo.
MagicRings.ringCount: Number of concentric rings to draw (1-10).
MagicRings.attenuation: Glow falloff — higher values produce tighter glow.
MagicRings.scaleRate: How much rings expand over time.
MagicRings.blur: CSS blur in px — creates a bloom/glow effect.
MagicRings.rotation: Static rotation of the pattern in degrees.
MagicRings.ringGap: Exponential base for angular cutaway per ring.
MagicRings.fadeIn: Duration of ring fade-in within cycle.
MagicRings.fadeOut: Start time of ring fade-out within cycle.
MagicRings.followMouse: Rings shift toward the mouse cursor.
MagicRings.mouseInfluence: Strength of mouse follow (when followMouse is true).
MagicRings.parallax: Per-ring depth offset based on mouse position.
MagicRings.clickBurst: Click triggers a brightness flash and scale pulse.

Magnet.padding: Specifies the distance (in pixels) around the element that activates the magnet pull.
Magnet.disabled: Disables the magnet effect when set to true.
Magnet.magnetStrength: Controls the strength of the pull; higher values reduce movement, lower values increase it.
Magnet.activeTransition: CSS transition applied to the element when the magnet is active.
Magnet.inactiveTransition: CSS transition applied when the magnet is inactive (mouse out of range).
Magnet.wrapperClassName: Optional CSS class name for the outermost wrapper element.
Magnet.innerClassName: Optional CSS class name for the moving (inner) element.

MagnetLines.containerSize: Specifies the width and height of the entire grid container.
MagnetLines.lineWidth: Initial rotation angle (in degrees) before pointer movement.
MagnetLines.className: Additional class name(s) applied to the container.
MagnetLines.baseAngle: Initial rotation angle (in degrees) before pointer movement.

MetaBalls.color: The base color of the metaballs.
MetaBalls.enableMouseInteraction: Enables or disables the ball following the mouse.
MetaBalls.enableTransparency: Enables or disables transparency for the container of the animation.
MetaBalls.hoverSmoothness: Smoothness factor for the cursor ball when following the mouse.
MetaBalls.animationSize: The size of the world for the animation.
MetaBalls.clumpFactor: Determines how close together the balls are rendered.

MetallicPaint.imageSrc: URL or path to the image used for the metallic paint effect. The image is processed internally.
MetallicPaint.seed: Random seed for pattern generation. Different values create different pattern variations.
MetallicPaint.scale: Scale of the metallic pattern. Higher values create more repetitions.
MetallicPaint.refraction: Amount of chromatic aberration (color separation). Creates the rainbow edge effect.
MetallicPaint.blur: Blur amount for the pattern transitions. Higher values create softer gradients.
MetallicPaint.liquid: Amount of liquid/wavy animation applied to the pattern.
MetallicPaint.speed: Animation speed multiplier. Set to 0 to disable animation.
MetallicPaint.brightness: Overall brightness of the metallic effect. Values above 1 increase brightness.
MetallicPaint.contrast: Color contrast of the effect. Higher values create more distinct light/dark areas.
MetallicPaint.angle: Rotation angle of the pattern in degrees.
MetallicPaint.fresnel: Fresnel effect intensity. Controls edge highlighting based on viewing angle.
MetallicPaint.lightColor: Hex color for the bright/highlight areas of the metallic effect.
MetallicPaint.darkColor: Hex color for the dark/shadow areas of the metallic effect.
MetallicPaint.patternSharpness: Controls the sharpness of metallic band transitions. Higher = sharper edges.
MetallicPaint.waveAmplitude: Intensity of the wave distortion effect.
MetallicPaint.noiseScale: Scale of the noise pattern. Higher = more detailed noise.
MetallicPaint.chromaticSpread: Multiplier for chromatic aberration spread between RGB channels.
MetallicPaint.mouseAnimation: When true, mouse position controls wave animation instead of auto-loop.
MetallicPaint.distortion: Amount of noise-based distortion applied to the pattern flow (0-1).
MetallicPaint.contour: Intensity of edge contour effect that warps the pattern along shape boundaries (0-1).
MetallicPaint.tintColor: Hex color for color burn tint effect. White = no tint.

Noise.patternSize: Defines the size of the grain pattern.
Noise.patternScaleX: Scaling factor for the X-axis of the grain pattern.
Noise.patternScaleY: Scaling factor for the Y-axis of the grain pattern.
Noise.patternRefreshInterval: Number of frames before the grain pattern refreshes.

OrbitImages.images: Array of image URLs to orbit along the path.
OrbitImages.shape: Preset shape: ellipse, circle, square, rectangle, triangle, star, heart, infinity, wave, or custom.
OrbitImages.customPath: Custom SVG path string (used when shape="custom").
OrbitImages.baseWidth: Base width for the design coordinate space used for responsive scaling.
OrbitImages.radius: Radius for circle, square, triangle, star, heart shapes.
OrbitImages.starPoints: Number of points for star shape.
OrbitImages.rotation: Rotation angle of the entire orbit path in degrees.
OrbitImages.duration: Duration of one complete orbit in seconds.
OrbitImages.itemSize: Width/height of each orbiting item in pixels.
OrbitImages.fill: Whether to distribute items evenly around the orbit.
OrbitImages.className: Additional CSS class for the container.
OrbitImages.showPath: Whether to show the orbit path for debugging.
OrbitImages.pathColor: Stroke color when showPath is true.
OrbitImages.pathWidth: Stroke width when showPath is true.
OrbitImages.easing: Animation easing: linear, easeIn, easeOut, easeInOut.
OrbitImages.centerContent: Custom content rendered at the center of the orbit.
OrbitImages.responsive: Enable responsive scaling based on container width.

PixelTransition.firstContent: Content to show by default (e.g., an or text).
PixelTransition.secondContent: Content revealed upon hover or click.
PixelTransition.gridSize: Number of rows/columns in the pixel grid.
PixelTransition.pixelColor: Background color used for each pixel block.
PixelTransition.animationStepDuration: Length of the pixel reveal/hide in seconds.
PixelTransition.aspectRatio: If true, the transition will not revert on mouse leave or subsequent clicks.
PixelTransition.className: Optional additional class names for styling.
PixelTransition.style: Optional inline styles for the container.
PixelTransition.once: If true, the transition will not revert on mouse leave or subsequent clicks.

Ribbons.colors: An array of color strings to be used for the ribbons.
Ribbons.baseSpring: Base spring factor for the physics controlling ribbon motion.
Ribbons.baseFriction: Base friction factor that dampens the ribbon motion.
Ribbons.baseThickness: The base thickness of the ribbons.
Ribbons.offsetFactor: A factor to horizontally offset the starting positions of the ribbons.
Ribbons.maxAge: Delay in milliseconds controlling how long the ribbon trails extend.
Ribbons.pointCount: The number of points that make up each ribbon.
Ribbons.speedMultiplier: Multiplier that adjusts how fast trailing points interpolate towards the head.
Ribbons.enableFade: If true, a fade effect is applied along the length of the ribbon.
Ribbons.enableShaderEffect: If true, an additional sine-wave shader effect is applied to the ribbons.
Ribbons.effectAmplitude: The amplitude of the shader displacement effect.
Ribbons.backgroundColor: An RGBA array specifying the clear color for the renderer.

ShapeBlur.variation: Selects the shape variation (0-3) used by the shader.
ShapeBlur.pixelRatioProp: Overrides the pixel ratio, typically set to the device pixel ratio.
ShapeBlur.shapeSize: Controls the size of the shape.
ShapeBlur.roundness: Sets the thickness of the border.
ShapeBlur.circleSize: Determines the size of the hover circle effect.
ShapeBlur.circleEdge: Controls the edge softness of the hover circle.
ShapeBlur.borderSize: Sets the thickness of the border.

SplashCursor.SIM_RESOLUTION: Fluid simulation resolution for velocity fields.
SplashCursor.CAPTURE_RESOLUTION: Resolution used for certain capture operations (rarely changed).
SplashCursor.DENSITY_DISSIPATION: Rate at which color/density dissipates over time.
SplashCursor.VELOCITY_DISSIPATION: Rate at which velocity dissipates over time.
SplashCursor.PRESSURE: Base pressure for the fluid simulation.
SplashCursor.PRESSURE_ITERATIONS: Number of Jacobi iterations used for the pressure solver.
SplashCursor.CURL: Amount of vorticity/curl to apply for swirling effects.
SplashCursor.SPLAT_RADIUS: Toggles simple lighting/shading on the fluid.
SplashCursor.COLOR_UPDATE_SPEED: Frequency at which pointer colors are re-randomized.
SplashCursor.RAINBOW_MODE: When true, uses randomly cycling rainbow colors. When false, uses the COLOR prop.
SplashCursor.COLOR: Hex color for the cursor effect when RAINBOW_MODE is false.
SplashCursor.BACK_COLOR: Base background color for the fluid. Not always used if TRANSPARENT is true.
SplashCursor.SPLAT_FORCE: Force of the fluid 'splat' on each interaction.
SplashCursor.SHADING: Toggles simple lighting/shading on the fluid.

StarBorder.as: Allows specifying the type of the parent component to be rendered.
StarBorder.customClass: Allows adding custom classes to the component.
StarBorder.color: Changes the main color of the border (fades to transparent)
StarBorder.speed: Changes the speed of the animation.
StarBorder.thickness: Controls the thickness of the star border effect.

StickerPeel.imageSrc: The source URL for the sticker image
StickerPeel.rotate: The rotation angle in degrees when dragging
StickerPeel.peelBackHoverPct: Percentage of peel effect on hover (0-100)
StickerPeel.peelBackActivePct: Percentage of peel effect when active/clicked (0-100)
StickerPeel.peelDirection: Direction of the peel effect in degrees (0-360)
StickerPeel.peelEasing: GSAP easing function for peel animations
StickerPeel.peelHoverEasing: GSAP easing function for hover transitions
StickerPeel.width: Width of the sticker in pixels
StickerPeel.initialPosition: Custom class name for additional styling
StickerPeel.className: Custom class name for additional styling

Strands.colors: Palette of hex colors cycled across the strands. Pass an empty array to use the built-in rainbow spectrum.
Strands.count: Number of strands woven through the animation.
Strands.speed: How quickly the strands ripple and flow.
Strands.amplitude: Vertical reach of each strand as it waves up and down.
Strands.waviness: Density of the curves along each strand.
Strands.glow: Strength of the luminous bloom around the strands.
Strands.taper: How sharply the strands fade out toward the edges.
Strands.spread: Separation between strands so they fan out instead of overlapping.
Strands.hueShift: Rotates the colors around the strands for variation.
Strands.intensity: Overall brightness and energy of the effect.
Strands.saturation: Vibrance of the colors. Above 1 makes them more intense, below 1 fades to grayscale.
Strands.opacity: Overall transparency of the rendered strands.
Strands.scale: Zooms the whole effect in or out to make the strands bigger or smaller.
Strands.glass: Renders the strands inside a refractive glass ball.
Strands.refraction: How strongly the glass ball bends the light passing through it.
Strands.dispersion: Amount of rainbow color separation along the edges of the glass ball.
Strands.glassSize: Size of the glass ball relative to the canvas.
Strands.className: Additional CSS classes to apply to the container.

TargetCursor.targetSelector: CSS selector for elements that should trigger the cursor targeting effect
TargetCursor.spinDuration: Duration in seconds for the cursor rotation animation when no target is locked
TargetCursor.hoverDuration: Duration in seconds for the transition when the cursor locks onto a target
TargetCursor.parallaxOn: Enables a subtle parallax effect on the corners when moving over a target
TargetCursor.hideDefaultCursor: Whether to hide the default browser cursor when the component is active

Aurora.colorStops: An array of three hex colors defining the aurora gradient.
Aurora.speed: Controls the animation speed. Higher values make the aurora move faster.
Aurora.blend: Controls the blending of the aurora effect with the background.
Aurora.amplitude: Controls the height intensity of the aurora effect.

Balatro.spinRotation: Base rotation amount affecting the shader effect.
Balatro.spinAmount: Amount of spin influence based on UV length.
Balatro.isRotate: Determines if the shader rotates continuously.
Balatro.mouseInteraction: Enables or disables mouse interaction for rotation.

Ballpit.count: Sets the number of balls in the ballpit.
Ballpit.gravity: Controls the gravity affecting the balls.
Ballpit.friction: Sets the friction applied to the ball movement.
Ballpit.wallBounce: Determines how much balls bounce off walls.
Ballpit.followCursor: Enables or disables the sphere following the cursor.
Ballpit.colors: Defines the colors of the balls.
Ballpit.ambientIntensity: Controls the intensity of ambient light.
Ballpit.lightIntensity: Sets the intensity of the main light source.
Ballpit.minSize: Specifies the minimum size of the balls.
Ballpit.maxSize: Specifies the maximum size of the balls.
Ballpit.size0: Initial size value for the cursor ball.
Ballpit.maxVelocity: Limits the maximum velocity of the balls.

Beams.noiseIntensity: Intensity of the noise effect overlay.
Beams.rotation: Rotation of the entire beams system in degrees.

ColorBends.speed: Animation time scale of the shader.
ColorBends.colors: Palette of up to 8 hex colors used to blend the bends.
ColorBends.transparent: Whether the background is transparent (uses alpha).
ColorBends.frequency: Wave frequency used in the pattern.
ColorBends.warpStrength: Amount of warping/distortion applied to waves.
ColorBends.mouseInfluence: How strongly the waves react to pointer movement.
ColorBends.parallax: Parallax factor shifting content with pointer.
ColorBends.iterations: Number of extra warp passes (1-5). Higher values create more complex patterns.
ColorBends.intensity: Brightness multiplier for the final color output.
ColorBends.bandWidth: Controls the width/falloff of each color band.
ColorBends.className: Additional CSS classes for the container.

DarkVeil.hueShift: Shifts the hue of the entire animation.
DarkVeil.warpAmount: Amount of warp distortion applied to the effect.

Dither.waveSpeed: Controls the speed of the wave animation.
Dither.waveFrequency: Sets the frequency of the wave pattern.
Dither.waveAmplitude: Controls the amplitude of the wave pattern.
Dither.waveColor: RGB color values for the wave pattern (0-1 range).
Dither.colorNum: Number of colors in the dithering palette.
Dither.pixelSize: Size of the dithering pixels for the retro effect.
Dither.disableAnimation: Disables the wave animation when set to true.
Dither.enableMouseInteraction: Enables mouse interaction with the wave pattern.
Dither.mouseRadius: Radius of the mouse interaction effect.

DotField.dotRadius: Radius of each individual dot in the grid.
DotField.dotSpacing: Spacing between dots in the grid.
DotField.cursorRadius: Radius of the cursor interaction area.
DotField.cursorForce: Force applied to dots when not in bulge mode.
DotField.bulgeOnly: When true, dots bulge around the cursor. When false, dots are pushed with physics.
DotField.bulgeStrength: Strength of the bulge effect around the cursor.
DotField.glowRadius: Radius of the SVG glow effect that follows the cursor.
DotField.sparkle: When enabled, a small fraction of dots sparkle at a larger size.
DotField.waveAmplitude: Amplitude of the wave displacement animation applied to dots.
DotField.gradientFrom: Start color of the diagonal gradient applied to dots.
DotField.gradientTo: End color of the diagonal gradient applied to dots.
DotField.glowColor: Color of the radial glow effect that follows the cursor.
DotField.class: Extra classes for the root wrapper.

DotGrid.dotSize: Size of each dot in pixels.
DotGrid.gap: Gap between each dot in pixels.
DotGrid.activeColor: Color of dots when hovered or activated.
DotGrid.proximity: Radius around the mouse pointer within which dots react.
DotGrid.speedTrigger: Mouse speed threshold to trigger inertia effect.
DotGrid.shockRadius: Radius of the shockwave effect on click.
DotGrid.shockStrength: Strength of the shockwave effect on click.
DotGrid.returnDuration: Duration for dots to return to their original position after inertia.
DotGrid.className: Additional CSS classes for the component.

EvilEye.eyeColor: Primary eye color in HEX format.
EvilEye.intensity: Brightness / HDR intensity of the eye color.
EvilEye.pupilSize: Size and darkness of the pupil slit.
EvilEye.irisWidth: Width of the main iris ring.
EvilEye.glowIntensity: Strength of the outer eye glow.
EvilEye.scale: Zoom level of the eye. Values > 1 zoom in, < 1 zoom out.
EvilEye.noiseScale: Scale of the fire/noise texture sampling.
EvilEye.pupilFollow: Intensity of pupil cursor tracking. 0 disables it.

FaultyTerminal.scale: Controls the zoom/scale of the pattern.
FaultyTerminal.gridMul: Grid multiplier for glyph density [x, y].

Ferrofluid.colors: Array of hex colors (up to 8) used to tint the fluid rim. Colors are spread across the surface by height; a single color makes the whole effect uniform.
Ferrofluid.speed: Multiplier for how fast the fluid churns and flows.
Ferrofluid.scale: Overall feature size. Higher values zoom in for larger, fewer blobs.
Ferrofluid.turbulence: Amount of domain distortion. Higher values create more chaotic, swirling motion.
Ferrofluid.fluidity: Smoothness of the merge between the two fluid layers. Higher = softer, more liquid blending.
Ferrofluid.rimWidth: Thickness of the glowing contour lines tracing the fluid surface.
Ferrofluid.sharpness: Contrast of the rim highlights. Higher values give crisper, thinner edges.
Ferrofluid.shimmer: Amount of fine grainy break-up applied to the rim. 0 = smooth lines.
Ferrofluid.glow: Overall brightness multiplier of the rim highlights.
Ferrofluid.flowDirection: Primary direction the fluid surface drifts.
Ferrofluid.opacity: Overall alpha of the rendered canvas.
Ferrofluid.mouseInteraction: Enables a magnetic spike that rises and glows under the cursor.
Ferrofluid.mouseStrength: Intensity of the magnetic cursor spike.
Ferrofluid.mouseRadius: Falloff radius of the magnetic cursor spike.
Ferrofluid.mouseDampening: Easing time constant (seconds) for the cursor to follow the pointer. 0 = immediate.
Ferrofluid.mixBlendMode: If true, stops rendering updates (freezing the current frame).
Ferrofluid.dpr: Overrides device pixel ratio; lower for performance, higher for sharpness.
Ferrofluid.className: Additional class names for the root container.
Ferrofluid.paused: If true, stops rendering updates (freezing the current frame).

FloatingLines.linesGradient: Array of hex color strings for gradient coloring of lines (max 8 colors).
FloatingLines.enabledWaves: Which wave layers to display. Can toggle individual waves on/off.
FloatingLines.lineCount: Number of lines per wave. Single number applies to all waves, or array for per-wave control.
FloatingLines.lineDistance: Spacing between lines. Single number applies to all waves, or array for per-wave control.
FloatingLines.topWavePosition: Position and rotation settings for the top wave layer.
FloatingLines.middleWavePosition: Position and rotation settings for the middle wave layer.
FloatingLines.bottomWavePosition: Position and rotation settings for the bottom wave layer.
FloatingLines.animationSpeed: Speed multiplier for the wave animation.
FloatingLines.interactive: Whether the lines react to mouse/pointer movement.
FloatingLines.bendRadius: Radius of the area affected by mouse interaction.
FloatingLines.bendStrength: Intensity of the bend effect when interacting with mouse.
FloatingLines.mouseDamping: Smoothing factor for mouse movement tracking (0-1).
FloatingLines.parallax: Enable parallax effect with mouse movement.
FloatingLines.mixBlendMode: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the canvas element.

Galaxy.focal: Sets the focal point of the galaxy effect as [x, y] coordinates from 0 to 1
Galaxy.rotation: Controls the rotation matrix of the galaxy as [x, y] rotation values
Galaxy.starSpeed: Controls the speed of star movement and animation
Galaxy.density: Controls the density of stars in the galaxy
Galaxy.hueShift: Shifts the hue of all stars by the specified degrees (0-360)
Galaxy.disableAnimation: When true, stops all time-based animations
Galaxy.speed: Global speed multiplier for all animations
Galaxy.mouseInteraction: Enables or disables mouse interaction with the galaxy
Galaxy.glowIntensity: Controls the intensity of the star glow effect
Galaxy.saturation: Controls color saturation of stars (0 = grayscale, 1 = full color)
Galaxy.mouseRepulsion: When true, stars are repelled by the mouse cursor
Galaxy.twinkleIntensity: Controls how much stars twinkle (0 = no twinkle, 1 = maximum twinkle)
Galaxy.repulsionStrength: Strength of mouse repulsion effect when mouseRepulsion is enabled
Galaxy.autoCenterRepulsion: Creates repulsion from center of canvas. Overrides mouse repulsion when > 0
Galaxy.transparent: Makes the black background transparent, showing only stars

GradientBlinds.gradientColors: Array of hex colors (up to 8) forming the animated gradient. If one color is provided it is duplicated.
GradientBlinds.angle: Rotation of the gradient in degrees (0 = horizontal left→right).
GradientBlinds.noise: Strength of per-pixel noise added to the final color (0 = clean).
GradientBlinds.blindCount: Target number of vertical blinds. Acts as an upper bound when blindMinWidth is set.
GradientBlinds.blindMinWidth: Minimum pixel width for each blind. Reduces effective blindCount if necessary to satisfy this width.
GradientBlinds.mouseDampening: Easing time constant (seconds) for the spotlight to follow the cursor. 0 = immediate.
GradientBlinds.mirrorGradient: Creates a mirrored ping-pong gradient progression instead of a linear wrap.
GradientBlinds.spotlightRadius: Normalized spotlight radius relative to the shorter canvas dimension.
GradientBlinds.spotlightSoftness: Falloff exponent for spotlight edge. Higher = sharper edge (values >1 increase contrast).
GradientBlinds.spotlightOpacity: Overall intensity multiplier for the spotlight highlight.
GradientBlinds.distortAmount: Sin/cos warp intensity applied to UVs for subtle wavy distortion.
GradientBlinds.shineDirection: Flips the bright side of each blind; useful for composition with other elements.
GradientBlinds.mixBlendMode: If true, stops rendering updates (freezing the current frame).
GradientBlinds.dpr: Overrides device pixel ratio; lower for performance, higher for sharpness.
GradientBlinds.className: Additional class names for the root container.

Grainient.color1: Primary light color used in the gradient blend.
Grainient.color2: Secondary accent color used in the gradient blend.
Grainient.color3: Deep base color used in the gradient blend.
Grainient.timeSpeed: Animation speed multiplier for the gradient motion.
Grainient.colorBalance: Shifts the palette balance toward dark or lighter tones.
Grainient.warpStrength: Strength of the wave warp distortion (0 = none).
Grainient.warpSpeed: Speed multiplier for the warp animation.
Grainient.warpAmplitude: Base amplitude for the warp distortion.
Grainient.blendAngle: Rotation angle for the color blend axis (degrees).
Grainient.blendSoftness: Softens the blend edges between color layers.
Grainient.noiseScale: Scales the noise frequency that drives rotation.
Grainient.grainAmount: Amount of film grain applied to the gradient.
Grainient.contrast: Overall contrast applied to the final color.
Grainient.gamma: Gamma correction for the final color.
Grainient.saturation: Saturation amount for the final color.
Grainient.centerX: Horizontal offset of the gradient center.
Grainient.centerY: Vertical offset of the gradient center.
Grainient.zoom: Zoom level for the gradient field.
Grainient.className: Additional CSS classes applied to the container.

GridDistortion.imgageSrc: The image you want to render inside the container.
GridDistortion.grid: The number of cells present in the distortion grid
GridDistortion.mouse: The size of the distortion effect that follows the cursor.
GridDistortion.relaxation: The speed at which grid cells return to their initial state.
GridDistortion.strength: The overall strength of the distortion effect.
GridDistortion.className: Any custom class(es) you want to apply to the container.

GridMotion.items: An array of items to display in the grid. Each item can be a string, JSX element, or an image URL.
GridMotion.gradientColor: Controls the color of the radial gradient used as the background.

GridScan.lineJitter: Animated jitter along the grid lines.

Hyperspeed.effectOptions: The highly customizable configuration object for the effect, controls things like colors, distortion, line properties, etc.

Iridescence.color: Base color as an array of RGB values (each between 0 and 1).
Iridescence.mouseReact: Enable or disable mouse interaction with the shader.

LetterGlitch.glitchColors: Controls the colors of the letters rendered in the canvas.
LetterGlitch.glitchSpeed: Controls the speed at which letters scramble in the animation.
LetterGlitch.centerVignette: When true, renders a radial gradient in the center of the container
LetterGlitch.outerVignette: When true, renders an inner radial gradient around the edges of the container.
LetterGlitch.smooth: When true, smoothens the animation of the letters for a more subtle feel.

LightPillar.topColor: Hex color string for the top gradient color of the light pillar.
LightPillar.bottomColor: Hex color string for the bottom gradient color of the light pillar.
LightPillar.intensity: Controls the overall brightness and intensity of the effect.
LightPillar.rotationSpeed: Speed multiplier for the pillar rotation animation.
LightPillar.interactive: Enable mouse interaction to control the pillar rotation.
LightPillar.glowAmount: Controls the glow intensity and spread of the light effect.
LightPillar.pillarHeight: Height scaling factor for the pillar distortion.
LightPillar.noiseIntensity: Intensity of the film grain noise postprocessing effect.
LightPillar.className: Additional CSS class names to apply to the container element.
LightPillar.mixBlendMode: CSS mix-blend-mode property to control how the component blends with its background.
LightPillar.pillarRotation: Rotation angle of the pillar in degrees (0-360).
LightPillar.quality: Rendering quality level. Lower settings improve performance on mobile devices. Mobile devices automatically downgrade from high to medium.

LightRays.raysOrigin: Color of the light rays in hex format
LightRays.lightSpread: How wide the light rays spread. Lower values = tighter rays, higher values = wider spread
LightRays.fadeDistance: How far rays fade out from origin
LightRays.followMouse: Make rays rotate towards the mouse cursor
LightRays.className: Additional CSS classes to apply to the container
LightRays.raysColor: Color of the light rays in hex format

Lightfall.colors: Array of hex colors (up to 8) used to tint the falling light streaks. Each streak is randomly but evenly assigned one of the colors; a single color makes the whole effect uniform.
Lightfall.backgroundColor: Hex color of the soft ambient glow behind the streaks.
Lightfall.speed: Multiplier for how fast the light streaks fall.
Lightfall.streakCount: Number of streak layers rendered per cell (1–16). Higher = busier.
Lightfall.streakLength: Length of the glowing tail trailing each streak.
Lightfall.glow: Overall brightness multiplier applied before tone mapping.
Lightfall.density: Vertical frequency of streaks. Higher values pack more streaks into view.
Lightfall.twinkle: Amount of per-streak brightness flicker. 0 = constant brightness.
Lightfall.zoom: Field of view into the tunnel. Higher values zoom further in.
Lightfall.backgroundGlow: Intensity of the ambient background glow.
Lightfall.opacity: Overall alpha of the rendered canvas.
Lightfall.mouseInteraction: Enables a soft light that follows the cursor and flares nearby streaks (no warping).
Lightfall.mouseRadius: Falloff radius of the cursor light.
Lightfall.mouseDampening: Easing time constant (seconds) for the cursor light to follow the pointer. 0 = immediate.
Lightfall.mixBlendMode: If true, stops rendering updates (freezing the current frame).
Lightfall.dpr: Overrides device pixel ratio; lower for performance, higher for sharpness.
Lightfall.className: Additional class names for the root container.
Lightfall.paused: If true, stops rendering updates (freezing the current frame).

Lightning.hue: Hue of the lightning in degrees (0 to 360).
Lightning.xOffset: Horizontal offset of the lightning in normalized units.
Lightning.speed: Animation speed multiplier for the lightning.
Lightning.size: Scale factor for the bolt size.

LineWaves.innerLineCount: Number of lines in the inner (center) wave region.
LineWaves.outerLineCount: Number of lines in the outer (edge) wave region.
LineWaves.warpIntensity: Intensity of the wave distortion effect.
LineWaves.rotation: Rotation of the wave pattern in degrees.
LineWaves.edgeFadeWidth: Width of the edge fade between inner and outer regions.
LineWaves.color1: First color channel in HEX format.
LineWaves.color2: Second color channel in HEX format.
LineWaves.color3: Third color channel in HEX format.
LineWaves.mouseInfluence: Strength of mouse influence on the wave pattern.

LiquidChrome.baseColor: Base color of the component. Specify as an RGB array.
LiquidChrome.frequencyX: Frequency modifier for the x distortion.
LiquidChrome.frequencyY: Frequency modifier for the y distortion.

LiquidEther.colors: Array of hex color stops used to build the velocity-to-color palette.
LiquidEther.mouseForce: Strength multiplier applied to mouse / touch movement when injecting velocity.
LiquidEther.cursorSize: Radius (in pixels at base resolution) of the force brush.
LiquidEther.resolution: Simulation texture scale relative to canvas size (lower = better performance, more blur).
LiquidEther.dt: Fixed simulation timestep used inside the advection / diffusion passes.
LiquidEther.BFECC: Enable BFECC advection (error-compensated) for crisper flow; disable for slight performance gain.
LiquidEther.isViscous: Toggle iterative viscosity solve (smoother, thicker motion when enabled).
LiquidEther.viscous: Viscosity coefficient used when isViscous is true.
LiquidEther.iterationsViscous: Number of Gauss-Seidel iterations for viscosity (higher = smoother, slower).
LiquidEther.iterationsPoisson: Number of pressure Poisson iterations to enforce incompressibility.
LiquidEther.isBounce: If true, shows bounce boundaries (velocity clamped at edges).
LiquidEther.autoDemo: Enable idle auto-driving of the pointer when no user interaction.
LiquidEther.autoSpeed: Speed (normalized units/sec) for auto pointer motion.
LiquidEther.autoIntensity: Multiplier applied to velocity delta while in auto mode.
LiquidEther.takeoverDuration: Seconds to interpolate from auto pointer to real cursor when user moves mouse.
LiquidEther.autoResumeDelay: Milliseconds of inactivity before auto mode resumes.
LiquidEther.autoRampDuration: Seconds to ramp auto movement speed from 0 to full after activation.
LiquidEther.className: Optional class for the root container.
LiquidEther.style: Inline styles applied to the root container.

Orb.hue: The base hue for the orb (in degrees).
Orb.hoverIntensity: Controls the intensity of the hover distortion effect.
Orb.rotateOnHover: Toggle to enable or disable continuous rotation on hover.
Orb.forceHoverState: Force hover animations even when the orb is not actually hovered.
Orb.backgroundColor: The background color of the container.

Particles.particleCount: The number of particles to generate.
Particles.particleSpread: Controls how far particles are spread from the center.
Particles.speed: Speed factor controlling the animation pace.
Particles.particleColors: An array of hex color strings used to color the particles.
Particles.moveParticlesOnHover: Determines if particles should move in response to mouse hover.
Particles.particleHoverFactor: Multiplier for the particle movement when hovering.
Particles.alphaParticles: If true, particles are rendered with varying transparency; otherwise, as solid circles.
Particles.particleBaseSize: The base size of the particles.
Particles.sizeRandomness: Controls the variation in particle sizes (0 means all particles have the same size).
Particles.cameraDistance: Distance from the camera to the particle system.
Particles.disableRotation: If true, stops the particle system from rotating.
Particles.pixelRatio: Sets the pixel ratio for sharper rendering on high-DPI screens.

PixelBlast.pixelSize: Base pixel size (auto scaled for DPI).

PixelSnow.color: Color of the snowflakes (hex or CSS color)
PixelSnow.flakeSize: Size of snowflakes in scene units
PixelSnow.minFlakeSize: Minimum flake size in pixels on screen
PixelSnow.pixelResolution: Pixel resolution - lower values create larger pixels for a more retro look
PixelSnow.depthFade: Depth fade intensity - higher values make distant flakes fade faster
PixelSnow.farPlane: Far plane distance for rendering - higher values show more distant flakes
PixelSnow.gamma: Gamma correction value for final color output
PixelSnow.density: Probability of snowflakes appearing (0-1) - lower values = fewer flakes
PixelSnow.variant: Shape of the snowflakes - square, round, or snowflake pattern

Plasma.color: Optional hex color to tint the plasma effect. If not provided, uses original colors.
Plasma.speed: Animation speed multiplier. Higher values = faster animation.
Plasma.direction: Zoom level of the plasma pattern. Higher values zoom in.
Plasma.mouseInteractive: Whether the plasma responds to mouse movement.
Plasma.scale: Zoom level of the plasma pattern. Higher values zoom in.
Plasma.renderScale: Resolution multiplier for the WebGL buffer (0.1-1). Lower values render fewer pixels.
Plasma.maxDpr: Upper limit for the device pixel ratio used by the renderer.
Plasma.targetFps: Frame rate cap for the animation. Lower values reduce GPU usage.
Plasma.iterations: Number of raymarching steps per pixel (1-60). Lower values are cheaper but less detailed.

PlasmaWave.colors: Array of two hex colors — one for each plasma wave band.
PlasmaWave.speed1: Speed of the first plasma wave.
PlasmaWave.speed2: Speed of the second plasma wave.
PlasmaWave.dir2: Direction multiplier for the second wave. Use -1 to reverse.
PlasmaWave.focalLength: Focal length of the camera projection.
PlasmaWave.bend1: Bend intensity of the first wave.
PlasmaWave.bend2: Bend intensity of the second wave.
PlasmaWave.rotationDeg: Rotation angle of the scene in degrees.

Prism.height: Apex height of the prism (world units).
Prism.baseWidth: Total base width across X/Z (world units).
Prism.animationType: Animation mode: shader wobble, pointer hover tilt, or full 3D rotation.
Prism.offset: Pixel offset within the canvas (x→right, y→down).
Prism.noise: Film-grain noise amount added to final color (0 disables).
Prism.transparent: Whether the canvas has an alpha channel (transparent background).
Prism.scale: Overall screen-space scale of the prism (bigger = larger).
Prism.hueShift: Hue rotation (radians) applied to final color.
Prism.colorFrequency: Frequency of internal sine bands controlling color variation.
Prism.inertia: Easing factor for hover (0..1, higher = snappier).
Prism.bloom: Extra bloom factor layered on top of glow.
Prism.suspendWhenOffscreen: Pause rendering when the element is not in the viewport.

PrismaticBurst.intensity: Overall brightness multiplier applied after accumulation.
PrismaticBurst.speed: Global time multiplier controlling ray motion & distortion.
PrismaticBurst.animationType: Core motion style: planar rotation, full 3D rotation, or pointer hover orbit
PrismaticBurst.colors: Optional array of hex colors used as a gradient (otherwise spectral)
PrismaticBurst.distort: Amount of bend/distortion applied to marching space (adds organic wobble)
PrismaticBurst.paused: Freeze time progression when true (animation stops)
PrismaticBurst.offset: Pixel (or CSS length) offset of focal origin from center
PrismaticBurst.hoverDampness: If > 0 applies an angular comb filter to produce discrete ray spokes
PrismaticBurst.rayCount: If > 0 applies an angular comb filter to produce discrete ray spokes
PrismaticBurst.mixBlendMode: Canvas CSS mix-blend-mode (e.g. lighten, screen) or 'none' for normal

Radar.scale: Zoom level of the radar pattern.
Radar.ringThickness: Thickness of the concentric ring lines.
Radar.spokeThickness: Thickness of the radial spoke lines.
Radar.sweepSpeed: Rotation speed of the sweep beam.
Radar.sweepWidth: Width of the sweep trail (higher = thinner).
Radar.sweepLobes: Number of sweep beams around the radar.
Radar.color: Primary radar color in HEX format.
Radar.falloff: Edge fade intensity based on distance from center.
Radar.mouseInfluence: Strength of the mouse offset effect.

RippleGrid.enableRainbow: Enables rainbow color cycling animation for the grid.
RippleGrid.gridColor: Color of the grid when rainbow mode is disabled.
RippleGrid.rippleIntensity: Controls the intensity of the ripple effect from the center.
RippleGrid.gridSize: Controls the density/size of the grid pattern.
RippleGrid.gridThickness: Controls the thickness of the grid lines.
RippleGrid.fadeDistance: Controls how far the fade effect extends from the center.
RippleGrid.vignetteStrength: Controls the intensity of the vignette (edge darkening) effect.
RippleGrid.glowIntensity: Adds a glow effect to the grid lines.
RippleGrid.opacity: Overall opacity of the entire effect.
RippleGrid.gridRotation: Rotate the entire grid pattern by degrees.
RippleGrid.mouseInteraction: Enable mouse/touch interaction to create ripples.
RippleGrid.mouseInteractionRadius: Controls the radius of the mouse interaction effect.

ShapeGrid.shape: Cell shape rendered across the grid.
ShapeGrid.hoverTrailAmount: Number of trailing cells highlighted behind the cursor.

SideRays.rayColor1: Color of the first ray layer in hex format
SideRays.rayColor2: Color of the second ray layer in hex format
SideRays.spread: Angular width of the ray fan — higher values create a wider spread between the two ray layers
SideRays.origin: Corner of the canvas from which the rays emerge
SideRays.tilt: Rotation of the ray fan in degrees — positive values tilt clockwise
SideRays.saturation: Color saturation of the rays — 0 renders in grayscale, values above 1 boost color
SideRays.blend: Balance between the two ray layers — 0 is all ray 1, 1 is all ray 2
SideRays.falloff: How steeply brightness diminishes with distance from the source — higher = tighter glow
SideRays.className: Additional CSS classes to apply to the container

Silk.speed: Controls the animation speed of the silk effect.
Silk.scale: Controls the scale of the silk pattern.
Silk.color: Hex color code for the silk pattern.
Silk.noiseIntensity: Controls the intensity of the noise effect.
Silk.rotation: Controls the rotation of the silk pattern (in radians).

SoftAurora.color1: Tint color for the first aurora layer.
SoftAurora.color2: Tint color for the second aurora layer.
SoftAurora.noiseFrequency: Base frequency of the Perlin noise.
SoftAurora.noiseAmplitude: Base amplitude of the Perlin noise.

ShinyText.shineColor: The color of the shine/highlight effect.
ShinyText.speed: Duration of one animation cycle in seconds.
ShinyText.delay: Pause duration (in seconds) between animation cycles.
ShinyText.spread: The angle (in degrees) of the gradient spread.
ShinyText.yoyo: If true, the animation reverses direction instead of looping.
ShinyText.pauseOnHover: Pauses the animation when the user hovers over the text.
ShinyText.direction: The direction the shine moves across the text.
ShinyText.disabled: Disables the shiny effect when set to true.
ShinyText.className: Adds custom classes to the root element.

Shuffle.className: Optional CSS class for the wrapper element.
Shuffle.style: Inline styles applied to the wrapper element.
Shuffle.shuffleDirection: Direction the per-letter strip slides to reveal the final character.
Shuffle.duration: Duration (s) of the strip slide per letter.
Shuffle.maxDelay: Max random delay per strip when animationMode = "random".
Shuffle.ease: GSAP ease for sliding and color tween.
Shuffle.threshold: Portion of the element that must enter view before starting.
Shuffle.tag: HTML tag to render for the text container.
Shuffle.textAlign: Text alignment applied via inline style.
Shuffle.onShuffleComplete: Called after a full run completes (and on each loop repeat).
Shuffle.shuffleTimes: How many interim scrambled glyphs to scroll past before the final char.
Shuffle.animationMode: Odd/even staggered strips or random per-strip delays.
Shuffle.scrambleCharset: Characters to use for interim scrambles; empty keeps original copies.
Shuffle.colorFrom: Optional starting text color while shuffling.
Shuffle.colorTo: Optional final text color to tween to.
Shuffle.triggerOnce: Auto-run only on first scroll into view.
Shuffle.respectReducedMotion: Skip animation if user prefers reduced motion.
Shuffle.triggerOnHover: Allow re-playing the animation on hover after it completes.

SplitText.className: Additional class names to style the component.
SplitText.delay: Delay between animations for each letter (in ms).
SplitText.duration: Duration of each letter animation (in seconds).
SplitText.ease: GSAP easing function for the animation.
SplitText.from: Initial GSAP properties for each letter/word.
SplitText.to: Target GSAP properties for each letter/word.
SplitText.threshold: Intersection threshold to trigger the animation (0-1).
SplitText.textAlign: Callback function when all animations complete.
SplitText.onLetterAnimationComplete: Callback function when all animations complete.

TextCursor.text: The text string to display as the trail.
TextCursor.spacing: The spacing in pixels between each trail point.
TextCursor.followMouseDirection: If true, each text rotates to follow the mouse direction.
TextCursor.randomFloat: If true, enables random floating offsets in position and rotation for a dynamic effect.
TextCursor.exitDuration: The duration in seconds for the exit animation of each trail item.
TextCursor.removalInterval: The interval in milliseconds between removing trail items when the mouse stops moving.
TextCursor.maxPoints: The maximum number of trail points to display.

TextPressure.text: Text content that will be displayed and animated.
TextPressure.fontFamily: Name of the variable font family.
TextPressure.fontUrl: URL for the variable font file (needed)
TextPressure.flex: Whether the characters are spaced using flex layout.
TextPressure.scale: If true, vertically scales the text to fill its container height.
TextPressure.alpha: If true, applies an opacity effect based on cursor distance.
TextPressure.stroke: If true, adds a stroke effect around characters.
TextPressure.width: If true, varies the variable-font "width" axis.
TextPressure.weight: If true, varies the variable-font "weight" axis.
TextPressure.italic: If true, varies the variable-font "italics" axis.
TextPressure.textColor: The fill color of the text
TextPressure.strokeColor: The stroke color that will be applied to the text when "stroke" is set to true
TextPressure.className: Additional class for styling the <h1> wrapper.
TextPressure.minFontSize: Sets a minimum font-size to avoid overly tiny text on smaller screens.

TextType.text: Text or array of texts to type out
TextType.as: HTML tag to render the component as
TextType.pauseDuration: Time to wait between typing and deleting
TextType.loop: Whether to loop through texts array
TextType.cursorClassName: Optional class name for cursor styling
TextType.textColors: Array of colors for each sentence
TextType.variableSpeed: Random typing speed within range for human-like feel
TextType.onSentenceComplete: Callback fired after each sentence is finished
TextType.startOnVisible: Start typing when component is visible in viewport

TrueFocus.sentence: The text to display with the focus animation.
TrueFocus.separator: Optional string used to separate words in the sentence.
TrueFocus.manualMode: Disables automatic animation when set to true.
TrueFocus.blurAmount: The amount of blur applied to non-active words.
TrueFocus.borderColor: The color of the focus borders.
TrueFocus.glowColor: The color of the glowing effect on the borders.
TrueFocus.animationDuration: The duration of the animation for each word.
TrueFocus.pauseBetweenAnimations: Time to pause between focusing on each word (in auto mode).

VariableProximity.label: The text content to display.
VariableProximity.toFontVariationSettings: The variation settings to reach at cursor proximity.
VariableProximity.containerRef: Reference to container for relative calculations.
VariableProximity.radius: Proximity radius to influence the effect.
VariableProximity.falloff: Type of falloff for the effect.

CursorGrid.cellSize: Size of each grid cell in pixels.
CursorGrid.color: Color of the cell strokes, fills and pulses.
CursorGrid.radius: Radius in pixels around the cursor within which cells light up.
CursorGrid.falloff: Curve mapping distance from the cursor to cell brightness.
CursorGrid.holdTime: How long in milliseconds a cell stays lit before it starts fading.
CursorGrid.fadeDuration: How long in milliseconds a fully lit cell takes to fade out.
CursorGrid.lineWidth: Stroke width of the cell outlines.
CursorGrid.maxOpacity: Peak opacity of a cell at the cursor position.
CursorGrid.fillOpacity: Translucent fill of lit cells; 0 disables the fill.
CursorGrid.gridOpacity: Opacity of a faint always-visible lattice; 0 hides it.
CursorGrid.cellRadius: Corner radius of the cells in pixels.
CursorGrid.clickPulse: Emit an expanding ring of lit cells on click.
CursorGrid.pulseSpeed: Expansion speed of the click ring in pixels per second.
CursorGrid.className: Additional CSS classes for the wrapper.

ElasticMesh.image: Optional image URL to warp. When empty, a color gradient surface is rendered instead.
ElasticMesh.color1: Top color of the gradient surface.
ElasticMesh.color2: Bottom color of the gradient surface.
ElasticMesh.showGrid: Draw the mesh lattice over the surface.
ElasticMesh.gridDensity: Number of lattice cells across the sheet.
ElasticMesh.highlight: Specular highlight color used by the shading.
ElasticMesh.borderRadius: Corner radius of the sheet in pixels.
ElasticMesh.stiffness: How hard the mesh springs back to flat. Higher settles faster.
ElasticMesh.damping: How quickly wobbles die out. Higher damping settles faster with fewer oscillations.
ElasticMesh.grabRadius: How much of the sheet the pointer grabs (fraction of the surface).
ElasticMesh.pull: How far the surface stretches toward the pointer.
ElasticMesh.wobble: Neighbor coupling — higher spreads the deformation into more visible ripples.
ElasticMesh.tilt: Perspective tilt of the sheet in degrees.
ElasticMesh.shading: Fake lighting strength that gives the warp depth. Keep above 0 to read the deformation.
ElasticMesh.interaction: Whether the mesh reacts to hover or only while dragging.
ElasticMesh.enabled: Enables or disables the pointer interaction.
ElasticMesh.className: Additional class names for the container.

GlowCursor.color: Color at the bright head of the trail.
GlowCursor.secondaryColor: Color blended into the end of the trail.
GlowCursor.trailLength: Number of smoothed points used to build the trail, from 2 to 64.
GlowCursor.trailWidth: Width of the luminous trail core in pixels.
GlowCursor.trailTaper: How strongly the trail narrows and dims toward its tail.
GlowCursor.followSpeed: How quickly the glowing head catches the pointer.
GlowCursor.glowIntensity: Strength of the soft inverse-square halo around the trail.
GlowCursor.glowSpread: Distance the outer glow spreads from the trail core.
GlowCursor.hotspot: Amount of white-hot color added to the brightest part of the trail.
GlowCursor.brightness: Final luminance multiplier for the shader.
GlowCursor.pulseSpeed: Speed of the energy pulse travelling through the trail. Set to 0 to stop it.
GlowCursor.noiseStrength: Amount of fine animated texture in the glow.
GlowCursor.idleFade: Fade the effect when the pointer stops or leaves the container.
GlowCursor.idleTimeout: Idle time in milliseconds before fading begins.
GlowCursor.fadeDuration: Approximate duration of the idle fade in milliseconds.
GlowCursor.blendMode: CSS blend mode used to composite the canvas over its content.
GlowCursor.maxDevicePixelRatio: Render-resolution cap for balancing sharpness and GPU cost.
GlowCursor.enabled: Enable or fade out the cursor effect.
GlowCursor.children: Optional content rendered beneath the interactive trail.

HalftoneReveal.src: Image URL rendered as a halftone print.
HalftoneReveal.paperColor: Colour of the paper behind the ink (hex).
HalftoneReveal.mode: Screen model: single ink, two-ink riso, or a CMYK rosette.
HalftoneReveal.dotSize: Overall scale of each ink dot.
HalftoneReveal.dotDensity: Number of dot cells across the frame.
HalftoneReveal.angle: Rotation of the halftone screen, in degrees.
HalftoneReveal.revealRadius: Radius of the sharp loupe around the cursor.
HalftoneReveal.edge: Hardness of the loupe boundary (0 soft, 1 hard).
HalftoneReveal.follow: Loupe follow time in seconds (lower = snappier).
HalftoneReveal.idleReveal: Baseline sharpness applied everywhere with no cursor.

PixelSwap.firstContent: Content shown in the initial state.
PixelSwap.secondContent: Content revealed after the pixel cover.
PixelSwap.pixelSize: Square pixel edge length in pixels. Grown automatically when the grid would exceed 320 pixels.
PixelSwap.pixelRadius: Corner rounding of each pixel as a percentage (0 = square, 50 = circle).
PixelSwap.pixelScale: Size each pixel starts at, relative to its final size.
PixelSwap.fade: Fade each pixel in as it opens. Disable for a hard pixel pop.
PixelSwap.pixelDuration: Time a single pixel takes to open, in milliseconds.
PixelSwap.randomness: Noise mixed into the pattern order, from 0 (strict) to 1 (fully scattered).
PixelSwap.pixelSpin: Degrees each pixel rotates as it opens.
PixelSwap.easing: Easing applied to each pixel as it opens.
PixelSwap.trigger: Interaction that requests a content swap.
PixelSwap.initialActive: Whether the second content is initially visible.
PixelSwap.active: Controlled active state. Use with trigger="manual" for external control.
PixelSwap.onActiveChange: Called whenever an interaction requests a state change.
PixelSwap.onComplete: Called once the incoming content is fully revealed.
PixelSwap.aspectRatio: CSS aspect-ratio value for the wrapper.
PixelSwap.className: Additional class names for the wrapper.

RippleDistortion.src: Image URL the ripples distort. Cover fitted to the container.
RippleDistortion.brushSize: Diameter of each ripple the pointer lays down, in px.
RippleDistortion.strength: How far the image is pushed, as a fraction of its size.
RippleDistortion.swirl: Full turns the push direction sweeps through as a ripple builds. 0 gives a flat push, higher folds the image into caustics.
RippleDistortion.rings: Concentric swells inside each ripple. 0 is a single plain blob.
RippleDistortion.spread: How many times its own size a ripple grows to before it dies.
RippleDistortion.fade: How long a ripple survives, in seconds.
RippleDistortion.spacing: Pointer travel between ripples, in px. Higher leaves a sparser trail.
RippleDistortion.dispersion: Chromatic split between the red and blue channels as they refract.
RippleDistortion.glint: Sheen riding the shoulders of each ripple.
RippleDistortion.tint: Colour the disturbed water takes on.
RippleDistortion.tintAmount: How strongly the tint colours the disturbed water.
RippleDistortion.grayscale: Drain the colour out of the image so the folds read on tone alone.
RippleDistortion.trigger: What disturbs the surface: motion, clicks, or both.
RippleDistortion.clickStrength: How much larger a click ripple starts than a hover one.
RippleDistortion.quality: Resolution of the displacement buffer. Lower trades crispness for fill rate.
RippleDistortion.enabled: Toggle the effect on or off.

ScrollExpand.src: Image or video URL shown inside the frame.
ScrollExpand.mediaType: Whether the source is an image or a looping muted video.
ScrollExpand.poster: Poster frame used while a video loads.
ScrollExpand.title: Headline held over the frame that lifts away as the media takes over.
ScrollExpand.scrollHint: Small cue shown under the resting frame that fades away as soon as the scroll begins.
ScrollExpand.startWidth: Frame width before expanding, as a percentage of the stage.
ScrollExpand.startHeight: Frame height before expanding, as a percentage of the stage.
ScrollExpand.startRadius: Corner radius of the resting frame, in px.
ScrollExpand.endRadius: Corner radius once fully expanded, in px.
ScrollExpand.mediaZoom: How far the media is zoomed in at rest. It eases back to 1 as the frame opens up.
ScrollExpand.scrollDistance: Scroll length of the expansion, in multiples of the stage height.
ScrollExpand.holdDistance: Extra scroll the frame stays pinned at full bleed before releasing.
ScrollExpand.smoothing: Follow time in seconds. 0 locks the frame exactly to the scrollbar.
ScrollExpand.overlayScrim: Strength of the gradient scrim that fades in to keep overlay content readable.
ScrollExpand.useWindowScroll: Drive the expansion from the page scroll instead of the component’s own scroller.
ScrollExpand.children: Content that fades in over the media once it reaches full bleed.
ScrollExpand.className: Additional class names for the container.

SwarmCursor.accentColor: Color where the swarm is densest.
SwarmCursor.count: Number of particles in the swarm.
SwarmCursor.size: Radius of each particle, in pixels.
SwarmCursor.merge: How readily nearby particles fuse into a single body. Lower is gooier.
SwarmCursor.glow: Strength of the soft halo around the swarm.
SwarmCursor.spread: Radius of the cloud the swarm orbits the cursor at.
SwarmCursor.separation: How strongly particles push each other apart.
SwarmCursor.speed: Travel speed and turn rate of the swarm, on a 1-10 dial.
SwarmCursor.wander: How strongly the drifting flow field pulls particles off their chase.
SwarmCursor.trail: Length of the motion trail each particle leaves behind.
SwarmCursor.scatterOnClick: Burst the swarm outward on click, then let it regroup.

AcidSquares.color1: Violet core color used for the dim depths of the corridor.
AcidSquares.color2: Pink mid-tone color used for the glowing crystal faces.
AcidSquares.color3: White highlight color used for the hottest edges.
AcidSquares.detail: Raymarch quality tier (20 / 32 / 48 steps). Higher looks richer but costs more.
AcidSquares.speed: Speed of the forward drift through the lattice.
AcidSquares.waveDepth: How far the view gently drifts in and back out as the corridor breathes. 0 holds it still.
AcidSquares.zoom: Field of view into the corridor. Higher zooms in.
AcidSquares.density: How tightly the boxes of the lattice are packed.
AcidSquares.glow: Gain applied to the accumulated light along each ray.
AcidSquares.exposure: Tone-mapping exposure. Higher values darken the render.
AcidSquares.spread: Controls how the ray step grows each iteration; strongly shapes the look.
AcidSquares.stepSize: Minimum ray step. Larger values thin out the glow.
AcidSquares.colorShift: Rate of the gentle brightness shimmer cycling over time.
AcidSquares.contrast: Contrast applied around the mid-tones of the final image.
AcidSquares.brightness: Overall brightness multiplier before tone mapping.
AcidSquares.opacity: Overall opacity of the effect over the transparent background.
AcidSquares.mouseInteraction: Enables a soft depression that sinks the lattice downward around the pointer.
AcidSquares.mouseStrength: How deeply the cursor presses the lattice down inside the affected area.
AcidSquares.mouseRadius: Size of the area around the pointer that collapses, as a fraction of the view height.
AcidSquares.blur: Softens the whole effect with a post-process Gaussian blur. 0 is crisp; 1 is a soft haze.
AcidSquares.grain: Adds a faint animated film grain over the final image for a subtle analog texture.
AcidSquares.grainIntensity: Amplitude of the grain overlay. 0 disables it entirely.
AcidSquares.className: Additional CSS classes applied to the container.

AeroShards.backgroundColor: Background behind the wind sculpture. Lighting and bloom adapt automatically to light surfaces.
AeroShards.shardColor: Primary body color for the shards.
AeroShards.accentColor: Accent color used to derive reflections, depth, and highlights.
AeroShards.placement: Places the sculpture while preserving a content-safe region.
AeroShards.material: Applies a complete lighting and surface finish.
AeroShards.detail: Balances shard count and size into a finished visual texture.
AeroShards.flow: Morphs the same shards between a flowing stream, circulating vortex, and twisted ribbon without restarting the animation.
AeroShards.rippleIntensity: Strength of the click/release wave and its accent-colored illumination. Set to 0 to disable ripples.
AeroShards.holdToGather: Press and hold to gather a softly circulating cloud around the cursor; release to unfurl. Respects interaction="none", pause, and reduced motion.
AeroShards.effect: Applies ordered color dithering or compact, shape-matched ASCII before postprocessing. Stylized modes use fewer, larger shards for readability; none preserves the original render.
AeroShards.scale: Zooms the complete shard field without changing its shard count or individual shard size.
AeroShards.spread: Controls how tightly the shards gather around the flow path.
AeroShards.depth: Controls front-to-back volume and perspective variation.
AeroShards.speed: Controls the shared travel speed of every shard.
AeroShards.spin: Controls how quickly shards roll around their direction of travel.
AeroShards.interaction: Disables interaction or enables damped cursor repulsion/attraction and click ripples across the field.
AeroShards.density: Fine-tuning multiplier for the shard count selected by detail.
AeroShards.shardSize: Fine-tuning multiplier for the shard size selected by detail.
AeroShards.stretch: Controls shard length without changing their overall count.
AeroShards.turbulence: Fine-tuning multiplier for the turbulence produced by motion.
AeroShards.glow: Fine-tuning multiplier for emissive edges and reflected highlights.
AeroShards.edgeSoftness: Controls analytic antialiasing without blurring the whole image.
AeroShards.bloom: Adds a soft halo without blurring the shards; on light backgrounds the halo uses the shard and accent colors.
AeroShards.grain: Adds screen-space film grain; set to 0 for a completely clean render.
AeroShards.chromaticAberration: Adds RGB edge separation; set to 0 for a color-neutral finish. Dither and ASCII use subtler separation to preserve their fine patterns.
AeroShards.transitionDuration: Controls the transition time for placement and flow formation changes.
AeroShards.interactionRadius: Scales the soft, flow-aligned reach of the cursor interaction.
AeroShards.interactionStrength: Fine-tuning multiplier for the selected interaction force.
AeroShards.className: Additional classes for the root element.
AeroShards.onError: Called when WebGPU setup or rendering fails.

CRTWarp.curvature: Strength of the CRT barrel distortion.
CRTWarp.scanlineFrequency: Number of scanline bands across the canvas.
CRTWarp.bloom: Intensity of the soft phosphor glow.
CRTWarp.pixelation: Pixel block size; 1 keeps the image smooth.
CRTWarp.mouseReact: Lets the pointer bend the signal.
CRTWarp.dpr: Maximum device pixel ratio used by the renderer.

GhostFibers.lineColor: Color of the thin fiber cores.
GhostFibers.glowColor: Color of the broad luminous bands.
GhostFibers.layers: Number of cumulative fiber layers, from 1 to 10.
GhostFibers.waveAmplitude: Strength of the recursive wave displacement.
GhostFibers.waveFrequency: Frequency of the recursive wave displacement.
GhostFibers.waveSpeed: Base speed of the layered waves.
GhostFibers.layerSpeed: Additional wave speed contributed by each layer.
GhostFibers.twist: Angular distortion applied during each iteration.
GhostFibers.twistFrequency: Radial frequency of the angular distortion.
GhostFibers.twistSpeed: Animation speed of the angular distortion.
GhostFibers.lineFrequency: Base frequency of the bright fibers.
GhostFibers.lineSharpness: Sharpness of the thin fiber cores.
GhostFibers.glowFalloff: Falloff of the broad glowing bands.
GhostFibers.glowIntensity: Brightness multiplier for the broad glow.
GhostFibers.brightness: Exposure used by the final tone mapping.
GhostFibers.blueBoost: Multiplier applied to the final blue channel.
GhostFibers.vignette: Strength of the original edge darkening.
GhostFibers.grain: Strength of the layered screen-space film grain.
GhostFibers.dpr: Canvas pixel density, clamped between 0.5 and 2.
GhostFibers.paused: Freezes the animation and stops its render loop.
GhostFibers.className: Additional CSS classes applied to the container.

Gradient Blinds.gradientColors: Array of hex colors (up to 8) forming the animated gradient. If one color is provided it is duplicated.
Gradient Blinds.angle: Rotation of the gradient in degrees (0 = horizontal left→right).
Gradient Blinds.noise: Strength of per-pixel noise added to the final color (0 = clean).
Gradient Blinds.blindCount: Target number of vertical blinds. Acts as an upper bound when blindMinWidth is set.
Gradient Blinds.blindMinWidth: Minimum pixel width for each blind. Reduces effective blindCount if necessary to satisfy this width.
Gradient Blinds.mouseDampening: Easing time constant (seconds) for the spotlight to follow the cursor. 0 = immediate.
Gradient Blinds.mirrorGradient: Creates a mirrored ping-pong gradient progression instead of a linear wrap.
Gradient Blinds.spotlightRadius: Normalized spotlight radius relative to the shorter canvas dimension.
Gradient Blinds.spotlightSoftness: Falloff exponent for spotlight edge. Higher = sharper edge (values >1 increase contrast).
Gradient Blinds.spotlightOpacity: Overall intensity multiplier for the spotlight highlight.
Gradient Blinds.distortAmount: Sin/cos warp intensity applied to UVs for subtle wavy distortion.
Gradient Blinds.shineDirection: Flips the bright side of each blind; useful for composition with other elements.
Gradient Blinds.mixBlendMode: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the canvas (e.g. 'screen', 'overlay', 'multiply').
Gradient Blinds.paused: If true, stops rendering updates (freezing the current frame).
Gradient Blinds.dpr: Overrides device pixel ratio; lower for performance, higher for sharpness.
Gradient Blinds.className: Additional class names for the root container.

GradientWaves.horizonColor: Distant haze color the waves fade into.
GradientWaves.waveColor: Mid color of the rolling wave bodies.
GradientWaves.crestColor: Highlight color of the nearest wave crests.
GradientWaves.speed: Animation speed of the undulating wave field.
GradientWaves.waveScale: Overall spatial frequency of the waves.
GradientWaves.waveRatio: Ratio between the short and long wavelength components.
GradientWaves.zoom: Field-of-view zoom into the wave field.
GradientWaves.height: Vertical offset of the horizon line.
GradientWaves.fogDepth: Distance over which the waves fade into haze and transparency.
GradientWaves.brightness: Overall brightness multiplier for the final color.
GradientWaves.parallaxStrength: Strength of the cursor parallax drift.
GradientWaves.grain: Overlay a whisper-subtle animated film grain on the effect.
GradientWaves.grainIntensity: Amplitude of the grain overlay. 0 disables it entirely.
GradientWaves.className: Additional CSS classes applied to the container.

LightTunnel.cableColor: Base color of the fibre-optic cables.
LightTunnel.pulseColor: Color of the light pulses travelling along each cable.
LightTunnel.tunnelColor: Tint color of the cable body fill (visible when tunnelOpacity is above 0).
LightTunnel.tunnelOpacity: Opacity of the cable body fill. 0 leaves the tunnel see-through so only rims and pulses show.
LightTunnel.speed: Overall scroll speed of the pulses down the tunnel.
LightTunnel.flowDirection: Whether the light travels toward or away from the vanishing point.
LightTunnel.pulseSpeed: Speed multiplier for the individual light pulses.
LightTunnel.pulseLength: Length of the glowing pulse along each cable.
LightTunnel.pulseBlend: How softly the pulse fades out at its edges — low is a crisp packet, high is a long smooth trail.
LightTunnel.pulseWidth: How much of the cable cross-section the pulse lights up — 1 fills the cable, lower narrows it to a filament.
LightTunnel.cableCount: Number of cables radiating around the tunnel.
LightTunnel.rimWidth: Width of the soft outline glow around each cable.
LightTunnel.waviness: Amount of wavy distortion applied along the tunnel depth.
LightTunnel.sway: Strength of the gentle rotational sway of the tunnel.
LightTunnel.size: Zoom / scale of the tunnel field.
LightTunnel.centerX: Horizontal offset of the vanishing point.
LightTunnel.centerY: Vertical offset of the vanishing point.
LightTunnel.glow: Intensity of the cable rim glow.
LightTunnel.fadeNear: Radius over which the tunnel fades in near the center.
LightTunnel.fadeFar: Radius at which the tunnel fades out toward the edges.
LightTunnel.brightness: Overall brightness multiplier of the effect.
LightTunnel.colorVariance: Adds subtle per-cable color variation so cables are not uniform.
LightTunnel.grain: Adds a whisper-subtle animated film grain to break up banding in the gradients.
LightTunnel.grainIntensity: Amplitude of the grain overlay. 0 disables it entirely.
LightTunnel.opacity: Global opacity of the rendered tunnel.
LightTunnel.mouseInteraction: Enables gentle parallax of the vanishing point toward the pointer.
LightTunnel.mouseStrength: Magnitude of the cursor parallax drift.
LightTunnel.className: Additional CSS classes applied to the container.

MoltenMetal.color1: Shadow color for the dim caustic glow.
MoltenMetal.color2: Midtone color for the flowing filaments.
MoltenMetal.color3: Highlight color for the hot filament cores.
MoltenMetal.speed: Animation speed of the liquid motion.
MoltenMetal.scale: Zoom of the caustic field (higher = more detail on screen).
MoltenMetal.glow: Gain applied to the accumulated filament glow.
MoltenMetal.coreSize: Thickness of the bright filament cores.
MoltenMetal.swirl: Amount of rotational swirl across the field.
MoltenMetal.fold: Turbulence / fold strength of the iterative warp.
MoltenMetal.blackPoint: Raises the dark floor so shadows fade to transparent.
MoltenMetal.colorMode: Palette mapping: molten, ember, or frost.
MoltenMetal.grainIntensity: Amplitude of the grain overlay. 0 disables it entirely.
MoltenMetal.mouseInteraction: Enables gentle drift of the field toward the cursor.
MoltenMetal.opacity: Overall opacity of the effect over the page.
MoltenMetal.className: Additional CSS classes applied to the container.

Scanner.color1: Primary color for the scanner gradient.
Scanner.color2: Secondary color for the scanner gradient.
Scanner.color3: Tertiary color for the scanner gradient.
Scanner.sweepSpeed: Speed of the scan line sweep.
Scanner.scanDirection: Direction of the scan line movement.
Scanner.mouseRadius: Radius of the mouse interaction glow.
Scanner.mouseStrength: Strength of the mouse interaction effect.

ShapeWaves.text: Optional text carved out of the field. Cells under the glyphs stay empty and the waves flow around them.
ShapeWaves.fontFamily: CSS font family used to draw the text cutout.
ShapeWaves.fontWeight: Font weight of the text cutout.
ShapeWaves.textSize: Text height as a fraction of the container height. Long text shrinks to fit the width.
ShapeWaves.shapes: 'mixed' draws dark bands as triangles, mid bands as circles and bright bands as squares. 'squares', 'circles' or 'triangles' use one glyph and vary its size per band instead.
ShapeWaves.cellSize: Size of one grid cell in CSS pixels.
ShapeWaves.dotSize: Glyph size as a fraction of the cell.
ShapeWaves.color: Glyph color. One flat color for the whole field.
ShapeWaves.hoverColor: Color the glyphs step towards inside a splash.
ShapeWaves.speed: How fast the wave bands morph over time. 0 freezes them.
ShapeWaves.scale: Size of the wave bands. Larger values give broader, calmer swells.
ShapeWaves.contrast: How sharply the field is cut into its three bands.
ShapeWaves.brightness: Shifts the balance between dark, mid and bright bands.
ShapeWaves.flow: Drift speed of the field in cells per second. 0 evolves in place.
ShapeWaves.direction: Drift direction in degrees, used when flow is above 0.
ShapeWaves.fade: Strength of the radial fade into the background towards the edges. 0 disables it.
ShapeWaves.interactive: Lets the cursor splash into the field, sending ripples that cycle the glyphs and light them up.
ShapeWaves.splashRadius: Size of a cursor splash in CSS pixels.
ShapeWaves.splashStrength: How much energy a splash drops in. Higher values throw wider, brighter ripples.
ShapeWaves.glow: Bloom on lit glyphs. 0 disables the glow pass entirely.
ShapeWaves.intro: Plays a spawn animation on mount: the shapes pop in along a wave that travels from the centre to the corners.
ShapeWaves.introDuration: Length of the intro wave in seconds.
ShapeWaves.introKey: Change this value to replay the intro wave without remounting.
ShapeWaves.paused: Freezes the wave motion. Splashes keep working.
ShapeWaves.onError: Called when WebGPU is unavailable or rendering fails. The background color still shows.
ShapeWaves.className: Extra class names for the root element.

SlicedWaves.color1: Highlight color for bars at the top of their travel.
SlicedWaves.color2: Deep color for bars at the bottom of their travel.
SlicedWaves.color3: Accent tint blended across the grid.
SlicedWaves.barThickness: Thickness of each bar relative to its cell.
SlicedWaves.speed: Animation speed of the travelling wave.
SlicedWaves.travel: How far each bar moves within its cell.
SlicedWaves.waveSpread: Phase step between columns; controls how tight the wave is.
SlicedWaves.rowOffset: Per-row phase offset that staggers the bars.
SlicedWaves.softness: Edge softness; higher values turn bars into glowing bands.
SlicedWaves.glow: Soft halo emitted around each bar.
SlicedWaves.contrast: Color contrast applied to the final render.
SlicedWaves.orientation: Bar orientation: 'horizontal' slats move vertically, 'vertical' slats move horizontally.
SlicedWaves.alternate: Reverse the travel direction on alternating rows.
SlicedWaves.mouseRadius: Radius of the cursor influence falloff.
SlicedWaves.grainIntensity: Amplitude of the grain overlay. 0 disables it entirely.
SlicedWaves.className: Additional CSS classes applied to the container.

Topography.lowColor: Color used for the lowest elevation bands.
Topography.midColor: Color used for the mid elevation bands.
Topography.highColor: Color used for the highest ridge lines.
Topography.speed: Animation speed of the morphing elevation field.
