Topography.morphAmount: Amplitude of the field morphing (how much the terrain shifts).
Topography.morphSpeed: How differently each control point animates over time.
Topography.bands: Contour line density (number of elevation bands).
Topography.scale: Zoom level of the topographic field.
Topography.pixelSize: Retro pixelation step (1 = smooth, higher = chunkier).
Topography.glow: Soft bloom radius around the contour lines.
Topography.contrast: Contrast of the line coverage (sharpens or softens lines).
Topography.brightness: Overall brightness of the contour lines.
Topography.fillBands: Softly tint the areas between contour lines by elevation.
Topography.grain: Whisper-subtle animated film grain over the effect.
Topography.grainIntensity: Amplitude of the grain overlay. 0 disables it entirely.
Topography.mouseInteraction: Lift the elevation field gently around the cursor.
Topography.mouseRadius: Radius of the cursor elevation bump.
Topography.mouseStrength: Strength of the cursor elevation bump.
Topography.className: Additional CSS classes applied to the container.

WebThreads.color1: Color of the first thread; threads blend from this toward color2.
WebThreads.color2: Color of the last thread; threads blend toward this hue.
WebThreads.color3: Hot-core color mixed into the brightest parts of the threads.
WebThreads.speed: Animation speed of the weaving motion.
WebThreads.frequency: Number of sine waves across the screen width.
WebThreads.spread: How far the threads fan out away from the pinch point.
WebThreads.taper: Per-thread amplitude growth; higher values fan later threads out more.
WebThreads.position: Vertical position of the woven strand (0 bottom, 1 top).
WebThreads.fanMode: Where the threads pinch together: center, left, or right.
WebThreads.glow: Brightness of the glow radiating from each thread.
WebThreads.falloff: How tightly the glow hugs the thread (higher = thinner filament).
WebThreads.mirror: Mirror the wave phase across the pinch point for a woven look.
WebThreads.shimmer: Add a subtle per-thread phase shimmer.
WebThreads.grain: Overlay a whisper-subtle animated film grain on the threads.
WebThreads.grainIntensity: Amplitude of the grain overlay. 0 disables it entirely.
WebThreads.mouseInteraction: Let the pinch point drift toward the cursor with a soft brightness bloom.
WebThreads.mouseStrength: Strength of the cursor influence on the pinch point and bloom.
WebThreads.className: Additional CSS classes applied to the container.

AccordionGallery.items: The panels to render. Each needs an image, and optionally a label, link and alt text.
AccordionGallery.defaultIndex: Index of the panel that is expanded on load, so the gallery never looks dead.
AccordionGallery.accentColor: Colour of the caption accent bar and the focus ring.
AccordionGallery.overlayColor: Colour used for the bottom legibility gradient and the dimming of collapsed panels.
AccordionGallery.grayscale: Desaturate collapsed panels and restore full colour on the expanded one.
AccordionGallery.showLabels: Whether captions reveal on the expanded panel.
AccordionGallery.duration: Duration of the expand / collapse transition in seconds.
AccordionGallery.ease: GSAP easing used for every transition.
AccordionGallery.parallax: Strength of the internal image drift as panels resize (0 disables it).
AccordionGallery.tilt: Degrees of 3D rotation applied to collapsed panels, easing to flat on the open one.
AccordionGallery.stagger: Delay between the caption bar and text reveal, in seconds.
AccordionGallery.trigger: How a panel expands on pointer devices. Focus and tap always expand too.
AccordionGallery.height: Height of the row in pixels (width of the column when vertical).
AccordionGallery.radius: Corner radius of each panel in pixels.
AccordionGallery.expandRatio: Fraction of the row the expanded panel occupies (0.2 – 0.9).
AccordionGallery.orientation: Lay the accordion out as a row or a column.

CurvedInput.value: Controlled value; leave undefined for uncontrolled usage.
CurvedInput.defaultValue: Initial value when the input is uncontrolled.
CurvedInput.onChange: Called with the new value on every keystroke.
CurvedInput.onSubmit: Called when the button is pressed or Enter is hit.
CurvedInput.placeholder: Placeholder text rendered along the curve when empty.
CurvedInput.buttonText: Label of the curved submit button.
CurvedInput.type: Semantic input type; email/number map to the matching mobile keyboard.
CurvedInput.name: Name attribute forwarded to the underlying input.
CurvedInput.ariaLabel: Accessible label; falls back to the placeholder.
CurvedInput.theme: Color preset; any explicit color prop overrides its theme value.
CurvedInput.width: Width of the input bar (pixels or any CSS width value, e.g. "100%").
CurvedInput.bend: How many pixels the center of the bar arches above its ends; negative bends downward, 0 is flat.
CurvedInput.height: Thickness of the input bar in pixels.
CurvedInput.cornerRadius: Corner rounding of the bar; the button rounds proportionally.
CurvedInput.fontSize: Font size of the curved text and button label.
CurvedInput.backgroundColor: Fill color of the input bar; overrides the theme.
CurvedInput.textColor: Color of the typed text and caret; overrides the theme.
CurvedInput.placeholderColor: Color of the placeholder text; overrides the theme.
CurvedInput.borderColor: Color of the outline stroke; overrides the theme.
CurvedInput.buttonColor: Fill of the submit button, the focus ring and the default icon chip; overrides the theme.
CurvedInput.buttonTextColor: Color of the button label; overrides the theme.
CurvedInput.iconColor: Fill of the icon chip; defaults to the button color.
CurvedInput.shadowSize: Size of the soft drop shadow under the bar.
CurvedInput.shadowColor: Tint of the drop shadow; overrides the theme.
CurvedInput.icon: Custom SVG content for the icon, centered at the origin; replaces the default envelope chip.
CurvedInput.className: Additional CSS classes for the wrapper form.
CurvedInput.style: Inline styles for the wrapper form.

DepthCarousel.items: Slides to display. Pass image URLs or objects with an image URL and alt text.
DepthCarousel.cardWidth: Width of each card in pixels.
DepthCarousel.cardHeight: Height of each card in pixels.
DepthCarousel.radius: Corner rounding of the cards in pixels.
DepthCarousel.tint: Colour multiplied over cards as they recede, shading the depth of the stack.
DepthCarousel.depth: Z distance in pixels between each card along the depth rail. Higher values push the stack further back.
DepthCarousel.spread: Lateral offset in pixels applied per card so the stack fans out to one side.
DepthCarousel.tilt: Degrees each receding card rotates around the vertical axis, revealing its edge.
DepthCarousel.tiltDirection: Which side the stack fans and tilts toward.
DepthCarousel.perspective: CSS perspective in pixels. Lower values exaggerate the depth foreshortening.
DepthCarousel.visibleCards: How many cards deep remain visible before further ones fade out.
DepthCarousel.falloff: How quickly brightness, tint and blur ramp up with depth.
DepthCarousel.blur: Maximum blur in pixels applied to the furthest visible card.
DepthCarousel.duration: Length of the advance transition in milliseconds.
DepthCarousel.ease: GSAP easing used for navigation transitions.
DepthCarousel.autoplay: Auto-advance the carousel, pausing on hover or focus.
DepthCarousel.loop: Wrap seamlessly from the last card back to the first.
DepthCarousel.showControls: Show the previous / next arrow buttons.
DepthCarousel.onChange: Called whenever the focused card changes.

DriftWall.items: Tiles to display. Each item has {'{'} image, title?, href? {'}'}.
DriftWall.tileWidth: Width of each tile in pixels.
DriftWall.tileHeight: Height of each tile in pixels.
DriftWall.gap: Spacing between tiles and columns in pixels.
DriftWall.radius: Corner radius of each tile in pixels.
DriftWall.tilt: Perspective pitch of the wall (rotateX, degrees).
DriftWall.turn: Perspective yaw of the wall (rotateY, degrees).
DriftWall.roll: In-plane rotation of the wall (rotateZ, degrees).
DriftWall.perspective: Perspective distance in pixels — smaller is more dramatic.
DriftWall.depth: How far the wall sits back from the viewer in pixels.
DriftWall.speed: Base drift speed in pixels per second.
DriftWall.direction: Primary drift direction; columns alternate around it.
DriftWall.variance: How much column speeds differ from each other (0-1).
DriftWall.pauseOnHover: Pause the whole wall while the pointer is over it.
DriftWall.lift: How far a hovered tile lifts toward the viewer in pixels.
DriftWall.fade: Strength of the edge and depth dissolve (0-1).
DriftWall.grayscale: Desaturate resting tiles; hover restores colour.
DriftWall.overlayColor: Tint laid over resting tiles, cleared on hover.

InfiniteSpiral.items: Images shown in the spiral. Objects may also include alt, href, target, label and id.
InfiniteSpiral.speed: Automatic travel speed in cards per second and the sensitivity of scroll-controlled motion.
InfiniteSpiral.animationMode: Selects automatic motion, pointer dragging, page-scroll control or all interactions.
InfiniteSpiral.radius: Depth radius of the helix in pixels.
InfiniteSpiral.perspective: CSS perspective applied to the 3D stage.
InfiniteSpiral.cardsPerTurn: Number of cards used for one complete revolution.
InfiniteSpiral.cardTilt: Additional clockwise card tilt in degrees.
InfiniteSpiral.centerScale: Scale multiplier for cards nearest the center.
InfiniteSpiral.edgeFade: Fraction of the outer travel range used for fading.
InfiniteSpiral.edgeBlur: Maximum blur applied near the edges.
InfiniteSpiral.pauseOnHover: Smoothly eases automatic motion to a stop while the gallery is hovered.
InfiniteSpiral.imageFit: Object fit used by every image.
InfiniteSpiral.grayscale: Grayscale amount applied to every image, from 0 to 1.
InfiniteSpiral.className: Additional class names for the root element.

LineSidebar.items: Labels rendered as the list of sidebar entries.
LineSidebar.accentColor: Color items and markers shift toward as the cursor gets close.
LineSidebar.textColor: Resting color of the item labels.
LineSidebar.markerColor: Resting color of the leading marker lines.
LineSidebar.showIndex: Show the zero-padded index before each label.
LineSidebar.showMarker: Show the marker lines (and short ticks) beside each item.
LineSidebar.proximityRadius: Vertical distance in pixels within which the cursor influences an item.
LineSidebar.maxShift: Maximum horizontal shift in pixels the label slides at full proximity.
LineSidebar.falloff: Curve mapping cursor distance to the proximity effect.
LineSidebar.markerLength: Length in pixels of the marker line; the in-between ticks scale from this too.
LineSidebar.markerGap: Gap in pixels between the labels and the markers.
LineSidebar.tickScale: Length of the in-between ticks as a fraction of markerLength.
LineSidebar.scaleTick: When true, the in-between ticks also grow with cursor proximity.
LineSidebar.itemGap: Vertical gap between items in pixels.
LineSidebar.fontSize: Font size of the labels in rem.
LineSidebar.smoothing: Transition duration in milliseconds for the proximity response.
LineSidebar.defaultActive: Index of the item selected on mount.
LineSidebar.onItemClick: Called when an item is clicked; the clicked item also becomes active.
LineSidebar.className: Additional CSS classes for the outer wrapper.

MorphSlider.items: Slides to morph between. Each item is an image URL with an optional caption.
MorphSlider.startIndex: Index of the slide shown on mount.
MorphSlider.transition: Character of the GPU displacement morph between slides.
MorphSlider.duration: Length of a full transition in seconds.
MorphSlider.ease: GSAP easing curve used to drive the transition progress.
MorphSlider.intensity: Strength of the displacement — how far the images warp during the morph.
MorphSlider.scale: Frequency of the procedural noise field (affects the Melt transition most).
MorphSlider.aberration: Amount of RGB split that peaks mid-transition and resolves to zero.
MorphSlider.drift: Idle drift / breathing applied to the current image so it is never fully static.
MorphSlider.autoplay: Advance slides automatically; pauses on hover.
MorphSlider.autoplayDelay: Seconds each slide holds before autoplay advances.
MorphSlider.loop: Wrap around from the last slide back to the first.
MorphSlider.radius: Corner radius of the slider in pixels.
MorphSlider.overlayColor: Tint used for the subtle edge vignette over the images.
MorphSlider.showCaptions: Show slide captions that animate in with each transition.
MorphSlider.showControls: Show the previous / next arrow buttons.
MorphSlider.className: Additional CSS classes for the outer wrapper.

OptionWheel.items: Labels rendered as the wheel options.
OptionWheel.defaultSelected: Index of the option selected on mount.
OptionWheel.onChange: Called whenever the wheel settles on a new option.
OptionWheel.textColor: Resting color of the option labels.
OptionWheel.activeColor: Color an option blends toward as it reaches the middle of the wheel.
OptionWheel.side: Edge of the container the wheel curves around.
OptionWheel.fontSize: Font size of the option labels in rem.
OptionWheel.spacing: Vertical distance between options as a multiple of the font size.
OptionWheel.curve: Depth of the circular curve; 0 flattens the wheel into a straight list.
OptionWheel.tilt: Angle in degrees between neighboring options; higher values curl the wheel tighter.
OptionWheel.blur: Blur in pixels added per step away from the middle.
OptionWheel.fade: Opacity lost per step away from the middle.
OptionWheel.minOpacity: Opacity floor for the furthest options.
OptionWheel.smoothing: Easing time constant in milliseconds; higher values feel heavier.
OptionWheel.inset: Padding in pixels between the anchored edge and the centered option.
OptionWheel.loop: Wrap around infinitely instead of stopping at the first and last option.
OptionWheel.draggable: Allow dragging the wheel with a pointer, in addition to scroll and arrow keys.
OptionWheel.soundUrl: URL of a short tick sound played when the selection changes; empty disables it.
OptionWheel.soundVolume: Playback volume of the tick sound.
OptionWheel.className: Additional CSS classes for the outer wrapper.

SpecularButton.children: Button label or any custom content.
SpecularButton.size: Preset padding and font size of the button.
SpecularButton.radius: Corner radius in pixels; clamps to a pill automatically.
SpecularButton.tint: Color of the glass background tint.
SpecularButton.blur: Backdrop blur in pixels behind the button.
SpecularButton.lineColor: Color of the moving specular highlight.
SpecularButton.baseColor: Color of the static edge stroke under the highlight.
SpecularButton.shineSize: Angular size in degrees of each shine streak along the edge.
SpecularButton.shineFade: How gradually each streak fades out at its ends, in degrees.
SpecularButton.thickness: Width of the highlight line in pixels.
SpecularButton.speed: Rotation speed of the sweep when autoAnimate is on.
SpecularButton.followMouse: Point the light toward the cursor.
SpecularButton.proximity: Distance in pixels within which the shine fades in as the cursor approaches.
SpecularButton.autoAnimate: Keep the shine always on with a rotating sweep, regardless of cursor distance.
SpecularButton.className: Additional CSS classes for the button.

BellToggle.offLabel: The face at rest. Its width sets how far the pill is clipped.
BellToggle.onLabel: The face after the yes press. The pill reserves the width of the longer label; only the visible part changes, so neighbours never shift.
BellToggle.icon (slot): Replaces the bell. Adjust ringPivot for a glyph that hangs elsewhere.
BellToggle.label: Constant accessible name. Falls back to offLabel.
BellToggle.color: Ink at rest: label, bell and hover tint.
BellToggle.size: 36, 44 or 52 pixels tall with matching type, icon and padding.
BellToggle.radius: Corner radius of the pill and of the clip cap.
BellToggle.ringAmplitude: Degrees of the first swing. Every later swing scales from it.
BellToggle.ringPasses: Half-swings before rest. 2 is a nod, 9 a peal.
BellToggle.ringDecay: How fast the swings die. 1 evenly, 2 the second is already small, 0.5 keeps shaking.
BellToggle.ringPivot: Where the icon hangs from, as a percentage of its height. 16 is the crown, 50 the centre.
BellToggle.crossfadeMs: The label and fill crossfade. Also all a keyboard toggle gets.
BellToggle.revealBounce: Overshoot of the unfurl. 0 is critically damped; 0.2 lets the cap pass its mark and return.
BellToggle.count: Notifications waiting. A rise while on rolls the badge and wobbles the bell.
BellToggle.badge: Show the count on the bell while on.
BellToggle.waves: Sound waves leave the rim on every swing.
BellToggle.clapper: Draw a bell with a clapper that swings a beat behind the body.
BellToggle.pressed: Controlled state. Outside changes only crossfade.
BellToggle.disabled: Dims the pill and ignores input. The state is kept.

BranchedMenu.items: Sections: label plus children (value, label, icon), or a leaf with a value. A section with children folds; a leaf selects.
BranchedMenu.defaultOpen: The section, or sections, open at first. -1 for none.
BranchedMenu.defaultActive: Value selected at first. Empty picks the open section's first child.
BranchedMenu.onSelect: A child or a leaf was picked.
BranchedMenu.color: The ink. Lines and idle text are mixes of it.
BranchedMenu.accentColor: The active line, the active label and the marker.
BranchedMenu.lineColor: The rail, trunk and branches. A solid colour, so joints never darken.
BranchedMenu.width: The widest the menu may be, in px. It shrinks to its content.
BranchedMenu.rowHeight: Height of a child row in px.
BranchedMenu.indent: Where child rows start, in px. Branches end just before it.
BranchedMenu.trunk: The trunk line's x position, in px.
BranchedMenu.radius: The curve of each branch, in px.
BranchedMenu.fontSize: Child text size in px. Headers are 1px larger.
BranchedMenu.drawDuration: The accent line's travel, in ms.
BranchedMenu.foldDuration: A section's fold and unfold, in ms.

CallChip.icon: The tool glyph. Pass your own through the icon slot. It rolls out when the call resolves.
CallChip.name: The tool name.
CallChip.status: Running wipes the fill across and ticks the counter. Done completes it with a wash. Error stops it, tints and shakes.
CallChip.expectedMs: Milliseconds the fill takes to reach its 90% park, the time you expect the call to take.
CallChip.size: Chip height in pixels. Font, padding and glyph follow.
CallChip.radius: Corner radius in pixels. Half the height is a pill.
CallChip.color: Ink for the text and the tool glyph.
CallChip.progressColor: The fill that wipes across while running.
CallChip.doneColor: The success wash and the check.
CallChip.errorColor: The stopped fill and the retry glyph on error.
CallChip.washOpacity: Strength of the success wash and of the error tint.
CallChip.shake: Error shake amplitude in pixels. 0 tints only.
CallChip.@retry: Emitted when the failed chip is clicked.

CodeSlots.value: Controlled code. Digits that arrive from outside land with the cascade; digits removed drain.
CodeSlots.defaultValue: Uncontrolled initial code, rendered already landed.
CodeSlots.@change: Emitted on every edit, including the clear at the end of a reject.
CodeSlots.@complete: Emitted once when the last hole is filled.
CodeSlots.status: error drains the slots last to first under the danger tint and clears the code; success merges the fills into one wash and locks the input.
CodeSlots.mask: Shows a dot instead of each digit.
CodeSlots.caret: Shows the blinking caret in the active slot.
CodeSlots.disabled: Fades the row and ignores input.
CodeSlots.accentColor: Fill of a landed digit, the active ring and the success wash.
CodeSlots.inkColor: Caret, and the tint of the active slot.
CodeSlots.dangerColor: Ring and fill colour while status is error.
CodeSlots.slotSize: Slot width in pixels. Height and digit size follow it.
CodeSlots.radius: Corner radius in pixels, capped at half the slot size.
CodeSlots.bounce: Spring overshoot of the landing fill. 0 is critically damped.
CodeSlots.settle: Seconds a digit takes to land or drain.
CodeSlots.rise: Pixels a digit rises into place. 0 fades only.
CodeSlots.cascade: Milliseconds between slots when several land at once or drain on reject.

CometDial.value: Controlled value. A change from outside launches the reading on the tap spring.
CometDial.step: Snapping grid, and the keyboard nudge.
CometDial.unit: Suffix after the figure. Empty hides it.
CometDial.label: Accessible name of the slider.
CometDial.accent: The lit arc, the bead and the comet.
CometDial.size: Diameter in pixels. Everything inside scales with it.
CometDial.sweep: Degrees the arc covers, with the gap centred at the bottom.
CometDial.thickness: Stroke width of the track and the arc. The bead follows it.
CometDial.speed: How quickly the reading arrives, 0 to 100.
CometDial.tapBounce: Ring-down after a tap. 0 stops dead.
CometDial.flickBounce: Ring-down after a full-speed flick. A slower release lands between the two.
CometDial.momentum: How far a flick carries the reading past where you let go. 0 drops it where released.
CometDial.cometReach: Degrees of trail behind the bead at full speed.
CometDial.cometWidth: Extra stroke width at the head of the trail at full speed.
CometDial.disabled: Dims the dial and ignores input.
CometDial.@change: Emitted on every snapped change, including during a drag.
CometDial.@changeEnd: Emitted on release and on a key, with the release velocity and the bounce it earned.

DodgeField.default slot: What flees. Omit it for the built-in pill, or slot in any element and read {'{'} dodges, gave, caught, fleeing {'}'} from the slot props.
DodgeField.taunts: Labels for the built-in pill: the first at rest, then one per dodge, the last once it relents.
DodgeField.notice: One line shown under the child on touch devices, where nothing dodges.
DodgeField.inkColor: The pill tint and text, the caught fill and the focus ring all derive from it.
DodgeField.contrastColor: Text colour while the pill is caught.
DodgeField.fieldHeight: Height of the invisible field in pixels; its width is the container.
DodgeField.reach: How far it bolts, in pixels, with the pointer on its home.
DodgeField.radius: Distance from home at which it starts to react, in pixels.
DodgeField.falloff: Exponent of the reaction curve. 1 drifts away from far off; 4 only flinches at the last moment.
DodgeField.fleeDuration: Settle time of the dart, in milliseconds.
DodgeField.returnDuration: Settle time of the glide home, in milliseconds.
DodgeField.returnBounce: Overshoot on the way home. 0.1 is a hair, 0.3 a visible wobble.
DodgeField.wall: At the edge of the field: stop dead, or fold the overflow back so it rebounds.
DodgeField.patience: Dodges before it gives in and sits still, at least 1. Never wrap a decline or close control in a field that dodges.
DodgeField.disabled: Sits still and stops counting; the child stays clickable.
DodgeField.@catch: Emitted when the child is clicked.

FlipCard.flipped: Controlled state: true shows the back. Omit it to let the card manage itself.
FlipCard.@flipChange: Emitted when a click, drag, flick or key lands on the other face.
FlipCard.axis: y turns the card sideways and drags horizontally. x turns it over the top and drags vertically.
FlipCard.flipOnClick: A press without movement flips the card.
FlipCard.draggable: Drag to turn the card by hand. On release it springs to the nearest face, carrying the flick velocity.
FlipCard.dragDistance: Pixels of drag for a half turn. 0 uses the card width, or its height on the x axis.
FlipCard.tilt: The card leans toward the cursor on hover.
FlipCard.glare: A soft sheen that follows the cursor.
FlipCard.glareOpacity: Strength of the sheen at its centre.
FlipCard.perspective: Viewing distance in px. Smaller is more dramatic.
FlipCard.damping: Damping of the flip spring. Lower overshoots more.
FlipCard.width: Card width in px, capped at the parent.
FlipCard.shadow: A soft shadow beneath the card that narrows as it turns edge on.
FlipCard.ariaLabel: Accessible name. The face is carried by aria-pressed.

FolderFloat.items: The pills that float out. A string is its own value.
FolderFloat.label: The line on the flap.
FolderFloat.sublabel: The dimmer line under it. Empty counts the notes.
FolderFloat.trigger: Open on hover, or toggle on press.
FolderFloat.closeOnSelect: Picking a pill closes the folder.
FolderFloat.physics: Once the pills land, a zero-gravity world takes over: they float, collide, and can be dragged and thrown inside the cloud.
FolderFloat.drift: Strength of the floating currents in the world. 0 holds still.
FolderFloat.folderColor: The back panel and its tab.
FolderFloat.paperColor: The paper edge that rises as it opens.
FolderFloat.height: Folder height in px, below the tab.
FolderFloat.spread: Half the widest the cloud may be, in px. Pills pack into rows within it.
FolderFloat.lift: Gap between the folder and the lowest row, in px.
FolderFloat.tilt: Most a pill leans, in degrees.
FolderFloat.flapAngle: How far the flap tilts toward you when open, in degrees.
FolderFloat.restAngle: The flap tilt when closed, in degrees.
FolderFloat.openDuration: A pill's rise, in ms. The close is 60% of it.
FolderFloat.stagger: Delay between pills, in ms. The close reverses the order.
FolderFloat.bounce: Overshoot of the rise. 0 lands dead.

FuseButton.label: The idle action.
FuseButton.undoLabel: The label while the fuse burns; the whole pill is the Undo button.
FuseButton.doneLabel: Shown with a check once the fuse burns out and settle is stay; announced to screen readers on arm.
FuseButton.icon (slot): The idle glyph; an archive icon when omitted.
FuseButton.color: Ink for labels and icons; the seam and tints derive from it.
FuseButton.size: Height 36, 44 or 52 pixels with matching type and icons.
FuseButton.radius: Corner radius in pixels; 22 is a full pill at the medium size.
FuseButton.undoWindow: How long the fuse burns and Undo stays on offer, in milliseconds.
FuseButton.fuse: The pill rim burning down clockwise, or a line along the bottom or top edge.
FuseButton.fuseThickness: Line height or rim stroke in pixels.
FuseButton.crossfadeMs: Blur crossfade between faces after a pointer press. Keyboard commits swap instantly.
FuseButton.commitOn: When {'@'}commit fires: at the press, with Undo as the revert, or only once the fuse burns out.
FuseButton.pauseOnHover: Leaving and coming back with a mouse freezes the fuse until the pointer leaves again.
FuseButton.settle: After the fuse ends: return to the idle face, or stay on a terminal done face until remounted.
FuseButton.disabled: Dims the idle face and ignores presses. Undo stays available while armed.
FuseButton.@undo: Emitted when Undo or Escape runs the action back.
FuseButton.@fuseEnd: Emitted when the window closes without an undo.

GlideSelect.options: The rows. A string is both value and label; a tag shows muted at the right.
GlideSelect.value: Controlled value. Outside changes never animate.
GlideSelect.@change: Emitted on a pick that changes the value.
GlideSelect.placeholder: Chip text while nothing is selected.
GlideSelect.accentColor: The check on the selected row.
GlideSelect.highlightColor: The gliding pill. The selected row rests on it at 60%, and the chip tint derives from it.
GlideSelect.textColor: Labels. Tags and the chevron derive from it.
GlideSelect.size: Chip 28, 32 or 44 pixels with matching rows. Large is the touch-first size.
GlideSelect.radius: Menu corner in pixels. Chip, rows and pill use 4 less so they stay concentric.
GlideSelect.menuWidth: Menu width in pixels, never narrower than the chip.
GlideSelect.placement: Which side the menu grows on. It flips when the chosen side would leave the viewport.
GlideSelect.align: Which chip edge the menu shares.
GlideSelect.popDuration: Milliseconds the menu takes to grow out of its corner. It leaves in two thirds of that.
GlideSelect.glideDuration: Milliseconds the pill takes to travel between rows. 0 is a conventional hover.
GlideSelect.rememberPosition: The highlight stays on the row the pointer left, so re-entry glides from there. Off, it clears on leave and the selected row shows again.
GlideSelect.disabled: Dims the chip and ignores input.
GlideSelect.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the chip and list.

HoldButton.default slot: Label shown while idle and holding.
HoldButton.doneLabel: Label that blurs in when the hold completes.
HoldButton.icon (slot): Optional icon rendered before the idle label.
HoldButton.doneIcon (slot): Optional icon rendered before the done label.
HoldButton.fillColor: Colour of the liquid fill, its wave, the glow and the focus ring.
HoldButton.fillTextColor: Label colour inside the fill; the ink inverts as the edge crosses it.
HoldButton.size: Height, padding and font size preset.
HoldButton.radius: Corner radius in pixels of the body, the fill and the focus ring.
HoldButton.fillDirection: Whether the liquid sweeps left to right or rises from the bottom.
HoldButton.holdTime: How long the press must last, in milliseconds. The fill moves at constant speed.
HoldButton.releaseTime: How fast the fill snaps back on an early release or a reset, in milliseconds.
HoldButton.pressScale: Squash of the button while a pointer holds it. 1 disables it.
HoldButton.wave: Scrolling meniscus on the leading edge of the fill.
HoldButton.waveAmplitude: Height of the wave crests in pixels.
HoldButton.glow: Glow that charges with the hold and pulses once on completion.
HoldButton.resetAfter: Milliseconds the done state stays before the button resets. 0 keeps it done.
HoldButton.disabled: Dims the button and ignores input.
HoldButton.@hold: Emitted once, on the frame the fill completes.
HoldButton.@tap: Emitted on a release shorter than 250ms that did not drift away.

JellyRadio.items: The chips. A string is both value and label.
JellyRadio.defaultValue: Initial value when uncontrolled. Falls back to the first item.
JellyRadio.@change: Emitted on the commit, before the motion ends.
JellyRadio.textColor: Label of an unchosen chip, and the hover tone.
JellyRadio.size: Chip height 28, 36 or 44 pixels. Large is the touch-first size.
JellyRadio.gap: Rest spacing between chips in pixels.
JellyRadio.radius: Corner radius in pixels. 18 is a pill at medium.
JellyRadio.swell: How much the chosen chip grows. It also sets the room the neighbours make.
JellyRadio.barge: Extra pixels every neighbour is shoved beyond that room. 0 only makes room.
JellyRadio.shrink: How much every unchosen chip gives up.
JellyRadio.jelly: The wide-before-tall split. 0 swells uniformly, 1.5 exaggerates it.
JellyRadio.bounce: One minus the damping ratio. 0 arrives and stops, 0.4 rings.
JellyRadio.stagger: Milliseconds per row step before a neighbour moves. 0 moves the row as a slab.
JellyRadio.stiffness: Spring stiffness of the chosen chip. Neighbours soften from it with distance.
JellyRadio.disabled: Fades the group and ignores input.

LatticeLoader.label: The verb while working.
LatticeLoader.doneLabel: The verb after status turns to done; the frozen time follows it.
LatticeLoader.errorLabel: The verb after status turns to error.
LatticeLoader.status: Drives everything: the wave runs, or freezes and dissolves into a check or a cross while the stopwatch stops.
LatticeLoader.pattern: The wave geometry. At 3 x 3: arrow, dots, orbit, ripple, snake, spiral. At 4 x 4: sweep, spin, rain, pulse, orbit, snake. A custom object gives one delay per cell in step units (null for a hole), an optional loop and scale, and lit: the share of the cycle a cell stays bright, 0.25, 0.35, 0.45 or 0.62.
LatticeLoader.grid: Cells per side. Each size has its own set of patterns and its own check and cross.
LatticeLoader.color: Ink for the cells, the verb and the stopwatch. Inherits the page colour by default.
LatticeLoader.cellSize: Cell side in pixels; the lattice is three cells and two gaps.
LatticeLoader.fontSize: Verb size in pixels; the stopwatch and row gap scale with it.
LatticeLoader.step: Milliseconds between neighbouring cells lighting; the whole loop scales with it.
LatticeLoader.idleOpacity: How visible the dark silhouette is.
LatticeLoader.glow: A halo on the lit cells and the mark.
LatticeLoader.glowColor: The halo colour. Empty follows the ink, and the mark colour for the mark.
LatticeLoader.elapsed: Controlled elapsed seconds. When set, the internal clock never runs.

PaperCrumple.src: Required image URL. PNG transparency is preserved. Remote image servers must allow CORS.
PaperCrumple.alt: Image description used by the fallback and the accessible hold control.
PaperCrumple.backSrc: Optional image printed on the reverse. Otherwise the back uses paperColor.
PaperCrumple.width: Unfolded paper width in pixels. Scales down to fit the stage with a 24px inset.
PaperCrumple.height: Unfolded paper height in pixels. Determines the sheet aspect ratio.
PaperCrumple.sceneHeight: Height of the full-width stage in pixels, including space to drag.
PaperCrumple.imageFit: Cover crops the texture; contain keeps the entire image and leaves unused space transparent.
PaperCrumple.releaseBehavior: Freeze the current crumple, unfold completely, or unfold with lasting crease relief.
PaperCrumple.crumpleAmount: Maximum fold amount while held, from 0 (flat) to 1 (fully crumpled).
PaperCrumple.crumpleDuration: Approximate settling time in seconds while holding. 0 makes the change immediate.
PaperCrumple.releaseDuration: Approximate unfolding time in seconds. Another press can interrupt it.
PaperCrumple.foldCount: Number of crease guides in the paper solver, from 3 to 16. Each seed produces a different arrangement.
PaperCrumple.foldSharpness: Blend from rounded wrinkles (0) to angular creases (1).
PaperCrumple.wrinkleDepth: Compression depth, from 0 to 2. Higher values produce a tighter wad and stronger residual folds.
PaperCrumple.creaseStrength: Residual relief from 0 to 1 for the creased release mode. Longer holds leave stronger creases.
PaperCrumple.paperColor: Color of the unprinted back of the sheet.
PaperCrumple.roughness: Material roughness, from smooth (0) to matte (1).
PaperCrumple.paperTexture: Fine paper-grain bump strength, from 0 to 1.
PaperCrumple.lightIntensity: Strength of the directional light that reveals folds.
PaperCrumple.lightAngle: Direction of the key light in degrees. 0 shines from above.
PaperCrumple.shadow: Enable self-shadowing and a soft drop shadow behind the paper.
PaperCrumple.shadowOpacity: Opacity of the cast and drop shadows, from 0 to 1.
PaperCrumple.draggable: Move the sheet while held. The grabbed material point follows the pointer.
PaperCrumple.dragRotation: Maximum tilt in degrees while dragging. 0 disables tilt.
PaperCrumple.dragRadius: Maximum resting offset on each axis, in pixels. The stage also bounds the resting position.
PaperCrumple.returnToOrigin: Restore and creased modes return to the center. Stay mode leaves the paper where it was dropped.
PaperCrumple.seed: Seed for a repeatable arrangement of folds and paper grain.
PaperCrumple.detail: Simulation detail, clamped to 32–96. Higher values add smaller folds and take longer to prepare.
PaperCrumple.disabled: Disable pointer and keyboard input and finish any active hold.
PaperCrumple.resetKey: Change this value to reset the position, crumple and accumulated creases immediately.
PaperCrumple.@stateChange: Reports holding, then the selected release state: flat, crumpled or creased.
PaperCrumple.@error: Called if WebGL initialization or image loading fails. The original image remains as a fallback.

PeekRating.@change: Emitted when a rating is committed by click, release or keyboard.
PeekRating.@preview: Emitted on every slot crossing while previewing, and with null when the preview clears.
PeekRating.icon (slot): Custom glyph that replaces the built-in shape.
PeekRating.labels: One label per glyph, shown in the tip while previewing. Without labels the tip shows the number.
PeekRating.activeColor: Colour of lit glyphs and of the focus ring.
PeekRating.tipColor: Background of the tip that follows the pointer.
PeekRating.size: Glyph size in pixels; spacing and the tip scale with it.
PeekRating.lift: How far previewed glyphs rise, in pixels. 0 makes the preview colour-only.
PeekRating.magnify: Scale of the glyph under the pointer.
PeekRating.riseDuration: Duration in milliseconds of each glyph’s rise and fall, and of the tip’s hop.
PeekRating.popScale: Peak scale of the pop on the committed glyph. 1 disables it.
PeekRating.showTip: Shows the tip above the pointer glyph while previewing.
PeekRating.allowClear: Clicking the current rating again, or Backspace, clears it to 0.
PeekRating.readOnly: Display only: no preview, no pop, announced as an image.
PeekRating.disabled: Dims the control and ignores input.
PeekRating.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the radio group.
PeekRating.className: Extra classes for the root element.

PromptBar.placeholder: Shown while the field is empty.
PromptBar.sources: Rows of the {'@'} menu and the plus button: key, name, description, icon (Hugeicons data or a Vue component), and attach: true for the row that adds files.
PromptBar.commands: Rows of the / menu: key, name (with the slash), description.
PromptBar.models: Rows of the model picker: key, name, tag. An empty list hides the picker.
PromptBar.efforts: Steps of the effort slider, low to high. The last step turns the field to the spark colour with drifting sparks. An empty list hides the control.
PromptBar.defaultEffort: The step selected at first. Empty picks the middle.
PromptBar.defaultModel: Key of the model selected at first. Empty picks the first.
PromptBar.busy: A response is in flight. The send tile stays ink and its arrow morphs into a stop square.
PromptBar.@send: Enter or the tile, with a non-empty draft or an attachment. The draft and attachments clear.
PromptBar.onAttach: Function prop, called when the attach row is picked. Return file names, or a promise of them, and they appear as chips.
PromptBar.onDictate: Function prop for the mic. Return the transcript, or a promise of it, and it lands in the draft. Omit to hide the mic.
PromptBar.background: The field surface, and the glyph on an armed tile.
PromptBar.color: The ink: text, icons, and the armed tile.
PromptBar.menuBackground: The surface of the menus and the effort popover.
PromptBar.sparkColor: The wash, the sparks and the slider at the top effort.
PromptBar.sparkBoost: How strongly typing drives the sparks at the top effort: they rise faster, grow and glow brighter with typing speed, and flash on each keystroke. No sparks are added. 0 keeps them calm.
PromptBar.width: Field width in px, capped at the parent.
PromptBar.maxRows: Rows the field grows to before it scrolls.
PromptBar.morphDuration: Arrow to square and back, in ms.
PromptBar.squash: Mid-morph pinch. The glyph narrows by this and grows taller to keep its area.
PromptBar.tilt: Mid-morph lean in degrees, mirrored on the way back.
PromptBar.pressScale: Scale of the send tile while a pointer is down.

PulseHeart.liked: Controlled state. Changes from outside land without a run.
PulseHeart.count: The number shown; a press adds or removes one. Rolls one glyph per press. For a multi-digit odometer with places and decimals, use Counter.
PulseHeart.@change: Emitted on every press with the new state and count.
PulseHeart.showCount: Shows the count; off collapses the pill to a circle.
PulseHeart.icon: Built-in glyph. Pass your own element through the icon slot.
PulseHeart.idleOutline: Draws the idle glyph as an outline. Off draws it as a muted solid.
PulseHeart.size: Glyph size in pixels; padding, gap and count size derive from it.
PulseHeart.likedColor: Colour after the flip, and of the hover tint and focus ring.
PulseHeart.pillColor: Background of the pill that beats under the glyph.
PulseHeart.duration: Length of the whole run in milliseconds; the flip is always at 40% of it.
PulseHeart.dotSize: How small the glyph gets at the flip, as a fraction of its size.
PulseHeart.overshoot: How far the glyph rebounds past rest on the way back. 0 lands without a rebound.
PulseHeart.beat: Percent the pill dips at the flip.
PulseHeart.rollDuration: How long the changed glyph of the count takes to roll, in milliseconds.
PulseHeart.disabled: Dims the button and ignores input.
PulseHeart.label: Accessible name; the count is appended to it.

RefineFrame.status: The stage. Each change tweens the media to that stage.
RefineFrame.default slot: The media: an img, video or canvas. It fills the frame.
RefineFrame.aspectRatio: The box reserved before and during generation, so nothing shifts.
RefineFrame.width: Frame width in px, capped at the parent.
RefineFrame.background: The paper behind the media, and the chip surface.
RefineFrame.color: The ink: chip text, the sweep and the retry pill.
RefineFrame.sweep: A soft band crosses the frame while it works.
RefineFrame.showStatus: The chip with the mark and the stage label.
RefineFrame.hideAfter: Ms after completion before the chip fades. 0 keeps it.
RefineFrame.labels: Chip text per stage: Queued, Generating, Refining, Ready, Failed.
RefineFrame.@retry: The retry pill was pressed. Without a listener, no pill.

RubberSegment.items: The slots, in order. A string is both value and label.
RubberSegment.value: Controlled value. A change from outside jumps the thumb without animation.
RubberSegment.defaultValue: Initial value when uncontrolled; the first item if omitted.
RubberSegment.@change: Emitted on a tap, on a drag release and on every arrow key.
RubberSegment.thumbColor: The rubber thumb, and the focus ring.
RubberSegment.activeTextColor: The label revealed inside the thumb.
RubberSegment.size: Track height 28, 36 or 44 pixels; font and padding follow.
RubberSegment.inset: Gap between the thumb and the track edge; the thumb corner is radius minus inset.
RubberSegment.equalSlots: Every slot the same width. Off, slots hug their labels and the thumb changes width per slot.
RubberSegment.stretch: How far a tap dilates the thumb across old and new slot before it contracts. 0 is a plain slide.
RubberSegment.squash: Pixels the trailing edge lands past the slot edge before relaxing. 0 removes the squash.
RubberSegment.speed: Scales every phase together; 0.25 is slow motion.
RubberSegment.glide: How far a flick carries the thumb before it snaps. 0 always lands on the nearest slot.
RubberSegment.draggable: Lets the thumb be grabbed, dragged and flicked.
RubberSegment.disabled: Dims the control and ignores input.
RubberSegment.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the radio group.

ScrubField.label: The field name. Drag anywhere on the chip to scrub; click without moving to type.
ScrubField.suffix: Unit after the number, also read by screen readers.
ScrubField.value: Controlled value; changes from outside land without motion.
ScrubField.defaultValue: Initial value and the dirty baseline: the ring turns off exactly here.
ScrubField.min: Lower bound; the rubber band starts here.
ScrubField.max: Upper bound; the rubber band starts here.
ScrubField.step: Granularity of drag and arrows; sets the decimals shown.
ScrubField.sensitivity: Pixels of travel per step. 1 is twitchy, 6 is precise.
ScrubField.rubberReach: How far past a bound the number can be pushed, as a percent of the range. 0 is a hard stop.
ScrubField.returnDuration: Duration in milliseconds of the critically damped snap back to the bound.
ScrubField.coarseMultiplier: Step multiplier while Shift is held, and for Page Up and Page Down.
ScrubField.fineMultiplier: Step multiplier while Alt or Option is held; adds a decimal.
ScrubField.showDelta: Shows the signed change in a pill riding the pointer.
ScrubField.showDirty: Rings the chip while the value differs from the default.
ScrubField.showFill: Fills the chip from the left in proportion to where the value sits in the range.
ScrubField.accent: Fill band, dirty ring and delta pill.
ScrubField.chipColor: Chip surface. Text inherits from the page.
ScrubField.disabled: Dims the chip and ignores input.
ScrubField.@change: Emitted on every step, key and typed commit.
ScrubField.@commit: Emitted on release, on a key step and on blur or Enter.

SlideCommit.label: The instruction centred in the pill; the capsule wipes it as you drag.
SlideCommit.doneLabel: The words beside the check once confirmed.
SlideCommit.errorLabel: Replaces the instruction, in the danger colour, after a rejected promise.
SlideCommit.onConfirm: Function prop, called when the handle reaches the end. Return a promise to show the spinner; it unfurls on resolve and springs home on reject.
SlideCommit.@done: Emitted when the done pill unfurls.
SlideCommit.@error: Emitted with the rejection reason; the component swallows it otherwise.
SlideCommit.handleColor: The handle and the ground it paints; the arrow colour is picked to read on it.
SlideCommit.dangerColor: Tint of the handle and error label after a reject.
SlideCommit.width: Track width in pixels; the travel scales with it.
SlideCommit.height: Track height in pixels; the handle is 8px smaller.
SlideCommit.radius: Track corner radius; the handle corner is 4px smaller so the two stay concentric.
SlideCommit.speed: How fast the unfurl and the return take over once you let go.
SlideCommit.returnBounce: Energy left when the handle returns to the wall: 0 stops dead, 0.38 fills the 8% squash.
SlideCommit.landingDip: How much the track dips as the done pill lands. 0 removes it.
SlideCommit.holdMs: How long the done pill stands before it closes back. 0 keeps it until the component remounts.
SlideCommit.disabled: Dims the control and ignores input.
SlideCommit.icon (slot): Replaces the arrow in the handle.
SlideCommit.className: Extra classes for the root element.

SlingButton.default slot: Pad content. Defaults to an arrow.
SlingButton.@send: Emitted on a loaded release, on a tap when tapSends is on, and on Enter or Space.
SlingButton.accentColor: The power arc, the loaded band and the dot.
SlingButton.wellColor: The seat the pad rests in.
SlingButton.size: Pad diameter in pixels. Seat, hit area and dot follow.
SlingButton.strokeWidth: Arc and band thickness in pixels. The band thins as it stretches.
SlingButton.armAt: Pull distance in pixels that loads the send.
SlingButton.maxPull: How far the band can stretch before it stops giving.
SlingButton.launchSpeed: Speed the band adds on release, in pixels per second. Sets how far the pad snaps through its seat.
SlingButton.recoil: Bounce of the return spring. 0 stops dead.
SlingButton.flight: How far the lead particle flies, in pixels. The rest scatter around that distance.
SlingButton.particles: How many particles a launch throws. Each gets a random angle, reach, size, drift, speed and delay. 1 is a single dot, 0 is none.
SlingButton.spread: The cone the burst fans across, in degrees, centred on the launch direction.
SlingButton.axis: Free pull, or one axis with a little give across it.
SlingButton.tapSends: Whether a plain tap sends. Enter always does.
SlingButton.disabled: Dims the pad and ignores input.

SloshGauge.value: The level, 0 to 100, controlled. Every change launches the liquid toward it.
SloshGauge.@change: The integer level on press, on each change while dragging, and on keys. Interactive only.
SloshGauge.interactive: Press or drag the tank to set the level, arrows to step. A marker appears at the level.
SloshGauge.showValue: A readout whose colour flips at the surface.
SloshGauge.disabled: Dimmed and inert. Value changes still animate.
SloshGauge.liquidColor: The liquid. The readout over it picks dark or light by itself.
SloshGauge.width: Tank width in px. The readout scales with it.
SloshGauge.radius: Corner radius in px, capped at half the smaller side.
SloshGauge.ticks: Lines etched on the right of the glass. 0 hides them.
SloshGauge.viscosity: 0 is a rigid gauge. Higher is slower to answer, longer to settle, and overshoots more.
SloshGauge.tilt: How far the surface leans per unit of speed. 0 keeps it flat.
SloshGauge.splash: How much of a slam the top and bottom give back. 0 swallows it, 0.8 nearly bounces.
SloshGauge.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the meter or slider.

SpringCheck.label: The words beside the box; the strike-through is exactly their width. Or use the default slot.
SpringCheck.checked: Controlled state. A change from outside animates on the spring.
SpringCheck.disabled: Dims the row and ignores input.
SpringCheck.color: Ink: the label, the ring, the rule and the focus outline.
SpringCheck.fillColor: The fill that swells out of the box centre.
SpringCheck.checkColor: Stroke of the tick drawn over the fill.
SpringCheck.boxSize: Box side in pixels; ring, gap and row height derive from it.
SpringCheck.boxRadius: Box corner radius in pixels; half the size makes a circle.
SpringCheck.fontSize: Label size in pixels; the rule thickness derives from it.
SpringCheck.bounce: How far the fill swells past full. 0 arrives dead, 0.5 rebounds twice.
SpringCheck.strikeLag: Where on the spring the rule starts: 0 wipes with the fill, 0.4 waits for the tick.
SpringCheck.doneOpacity: How much ink the words keep once checked.
SpringCheck.strike: Where the strike-through wipes from, or no rule at all.
SpringCheck.ariaLabel: Accessible name when the label is not text.

SquishSwitch.checked: Controlled state. Leave it out to let the switch keep its own.
SquishSwitch.@change: A tap, a drag past the middle, or a key.
SquishSwitch.label: A label beside the switch, wired to it.
SquishSwitch.thumbColor: The thumb while off. Empty mixes the on colour faintly into the track.
SquishSwitch.thumbOnColor: The thumb while on. Empty uses the off track colour.
SquishSwitch.height: Track height in px. The thumb and its inset follow.
SquishSwitch.radius: Track corner radius in px, capped at half the height.
SquishSwitch.speed: Stiffness of the settle spring, 0 to 100. Low is lazy, high is snappy.
SquishSwitch.stretch: How much the thumb lengthens with speed, 0 to 100. It narrows to keep its area.
SquishSwitch.hoverScale: The thumb swells to this on hover.
SquishSwitch.ariaLabel: Accessible name when there is no label.
SquishSwitch.className: Extra classes for the root element.
SquishSwitch.id: Id for the switch button; the label uses it.

StatusMark.status: The lifecycle state. Every change morphs the glyph in place.
StatusMark.progress: 0 to 1 while running. Leave it out for an indeterminate spinning arc.
StatusMark.label: Text beside the glyph (or the default slot). It dims and gets struck.
StatusMark.color: Ring, arc, cancelled cross and label.
StatusMark.doneColor: Ring, wash and check when done.
StatusMark.errorColor: Ring, wash and cross when failed.
StatusMark.size: Glyph size in pixels. The label gap is half of it.
StatusMark.strokeWidth: Stroke width in the 24-unit box. The ring shrinks to keep its margin.
StatusMark.dashes: Dashes in the idle ring, the ones that fuse into the arc.
StatusMark.fontSize: Label size in pixels. The strike scales with it.
StatusMark.spinDuration: Milliseconds per turn of the indeterminate arc.
StatusMark.arcLength: Share of the ring the indeterminate arc covers.
StatusMark.drawDuration: Milliseconds the check or cross takes to draw.
StatusMark.fillOpacity: The wash inside a finished ring.
StatusMark.strike: Strikes the label through when done.
StatusMark.strikeDelay: Milliseconds after the check starts before the strike wipes in.

SwipeRow.actions: The drawer, outermost first. Each has id, label, an optional icon (a component), an optional color for secondary actions, dismiss to fold the row when pressed, and onSelect. The first is the full-swipe action and always folds the row.
SwipeRow.actionColor: The full-swipe block that leaps and fills the row.
SwipeRow.drawerColor: The drawer base and the secondary actions.
SwipeRow.textColor: Row text and the keyboard toggle.
SwipeRow.height: Row height in pixels. The fold closes from it.
SwipeRow.radius: Corner radius of the row and the clipped drawer.
SwipeRow.actionWidth: Width of each action in pixels, so the drawer width too.
SwipeRow.direction: Which way you swipe. Everything mirrors.
SwipeRow.snapBounce: Overshoot of the open or close settle after a flick. Slow releases never bounce.
SwipeRow.resistance: How much of the finger the row keeps past the drawer, and the rubber-band beyond the commit point.
SwipeRow.collapseMs: How long a deleted row takes to fold shut.
SwipeRow.commitAt: Fraction of the row width the surface must uncover for the block to leap and a release to delete.
SwipeRow.fullSwipe: Off, the drawer is the end: no leap, no delete.
SwipeRow.disabled: Dims the row and ignores input.
SwipeRow.open: Controlled open state. Outside changes settle the row.
SwipeRow.@openChange: Called when a gesture or key opens or closes the drawer.
SwipeRow.@action: Called when any action button is pressed.
SwipeRow.@commit: Called after a full swipe or a press on a folding action, once the row has shut. Remove the row here.
SwipeRow.closeOnAction: Closes the drawer after an action is pressed.
SwipeRow.haptic: A short vibration on touch when the block leaps.
SwipeRow.label: Accessible name of the row.

SwipeToast.title: The first line.
SwipeToast.description: The dimmer second line. Empty hides it.
SwipeToast.actionLabel: The inverted button. Empty hides it.
SwipeToast.@action: Called when the action is pressed, before the close.
SwipeToast.open: Flip to false to close from outside. True again re-enters.
SwipeToast.@close: Called after the exit, and after the inline slot has collapsed. Reason is timeout, swipe, action, close, escape or programmatic.
SwipeToast.background: The card surface, and the action text.
SwipeToast.color: Ink: title, description at 62% and the action fill.
SwipeToast.width: Card width in pixels, capped at the parent when inline.
SwipeToast.slideMs: How long the rise and the drop take.
SwipeToast.settleBounce: Overshoot of the return after an abandoned swipe. 0 stops dead.
SwipeToast.swipeDistance: How far a slow drag must go before release dismisses. A flick always does.
SwipeToast.duration: Milliseconds until it closes itself. Changing it re-arms the fuse. 0 keeps it until dismissed.
SwipeToast.fuse: Which edge the line burns along. None keeps the timer but shows nothing.
SwipeToast.pauseOnHover: Hovering freezes the line and the timer.
SwipeToast.closeButton: Adds a cross at the end of the row.
SwipeToast.inline: In flow inside the parent instead of fixed to the bottom-right of the viewport.
SwipeToast.dismissible: Off removes the swipe and Escape.

TearTicket.image: Artwork behind the body. It shifts against the tilt for parallax and turns grey once used.
TearTicket.scrim: A fade from the paper colour up over the artwork, so text stays readable on busy images.
TearTicket.imageRadius: Corner radius of the artwork panel, in px. Set it to the ticket radius minus 8 to stay concentric.
TearTicket.orientation: Horizontal puts the stub on the right. Vertical puts the artwork on top and the stub at the bottom.
TearTicket.torn: Controlled state. Set it back to false to restore the stub.
TearTicket.@tear: Fires once the stub has come free and gone.
TearTicket.width: Ticket width in px. It scales down to fit a narrower parent.
TearTicket.stubSize: Size of the stub along the ticket, in px: its width when horizontal, its height when vertical.
TearTicket.holes: Perforation holes along the tear line.
TearTicket.notch: Radius of the notches at both ends of the tear line.
TearTicket.roughness: Optional jitter of the torn line between holes, in px. 0 keeps the edge perfectly straight and symmetrical.
TearTicket.tearAngle: Degrees of pull at which the last bridge gives way and the stub comes free.
TearTicket.stretch: How far a paper bridge stretches before it snaps, in px. Bridges far from the hinge reach it first.
TearTicket.resistance: How much the intact fibres hold the stub back, 0 to 1. The pull eases as bridges give way, so the paper fights hardest at the start.
TearTicket.rotate: A resting tilt of the whole ticket in the page plane, in degrees.
TearTicket.tilt: The ticket leans toward the cursor in 3D.
TearTicket.tiltReach: How far beyond the ticket the pointer still steers the tilt, in px. The tilt tracks the whole page.
TearTicket.parallax: How far the artwork travels against the tilt, in px.
TearTicket.background: Paper colour, also used by the fibres.
TearTicket.border: A hairline drawn along the cut edge of each piece, following every hole and notch.
TearTicket.borderColor: Colour of that hairline. Empty derives a faint tint of the text colour.
TearTicket.borderWidth: Thickness of the hairline in px.
TearTicket.stubBackground: Stub paper colour. Empty follows background.
TearTicket.recenter: Once the stub is gone, the remaining ticket glides over to sit centred in its original box.
TearTicket.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the stub. Enter or Space tears it.

ThoughtLine.label: The working line. It breathes, and it is the spoken text.
ThoughtLine.doneLabel: The settled line. Empty gives "Thought for", or "Done thinking" without the timer.
ThoughtLine.renderLabel: Wraps either string, for a sheen or a link. Inline content only.
ThoughtLine.glyph: The mark that breathes and dims. The #glyph slot replaces it.
ThoughtLine.steps: The trace beneath the line. Append as the agent progresses; the last step is current, earlier ones tick.
ThoughtLine.collapsible: The line becomes a toggle for the trace, with a chevron.
ThoughtLine.collapseOnSettle: Fold the trace into the line when it settles.
ThoughtLine.color: The ink of the line and the trace.
ThoughtLine.glyphColor: The glyph alone. Empty follows the ink.
ThoughtLine.fontSize: Type size in px. Everything scales in em.
ThoughtLine.breathPeriod: One breath, up and down, in seconds.
ThoughtLine.breathDepth: How far the glyph and label dim at the trough. 0 is no breath.
ThoughtLine.shimmer: A band of ink sweeps the working label. The label then leaves the breath to the glyph.
ThoughtLine.settleDuration: The settle chord, in ms: crossfade, dim, glide, fold.
ThoughtLine.settleBlur: Blur through the crossfade seam, in px.
ThoughtLine.working: Working or settled. True again starts a new clock.
ThoughtLine.settleAfter: Seconds after which the line settles by itself. 0 waits for working.
ThoughtLine.elapsed: Controlled seconds. The internal clock never runs.
ThoughtLine.showTimer: The live clock that freezes into the sentence.
ThoughtLine.@settle: Once per settle, with the frozen time.

VoicePill.accentColor: The waveform, the clock and the stop mark.
VoicePill.iconColor: The mic at rest, and the hover wash.
VoicePill.size: Footprint in px. The icon, the stop mark and the clock scale with it.
VoicePill.shape: A circle that opens into a capsule, or a rounded square.
VoicePill.reach: The room the capsule leaves before the waveform, in px.
VoicePill.showTime: An elapsed clock in the capsule, which grows to the left to hold it.
VoicePill.waveform: A history of the level scrolling through the capsule, past the clock.
VoicePill.slideToCancel: While held, sliding left drags the capsule contents along and reveals Cancel. Crossing the distance stops without a result.
VoicePill.cancelDistance: How far left a held pointer slides before it cancels, in px.
VoicePill.attack: How fast the level rises to a louder signal, in ms.
VoicePill.release: How long the level hangs after the sound drops, in ms.
VoicePill.sensitivity: Gain on the signal before the envelope.
VoicePill.floor: Waveform bar height when silent, as a fraction of its box.
VoicePill.openDuration: The capsule open and close, in ms.
VoicePill.pressScale: Scale of the button while a pointer is down.
VoicePill.mode: Auto: a tap latches, a hold stops on release. Hold: release always stops. Toggle: release never stops.
VoicePill.holdAfter: In auto, the press length after which a release stops instead of latching, in ms.
VoicePill.reactive: What drives the level. Mic asks for microphone permission on the first press and stops if it is refused.
VoicePill.disabled: Dimmed and inert. A listening pill stops.
VoicePill.ariaLabel: Accessible name. The state is carried by aria-pressed.
VoicePill.@start: Listening began, with the requested source.
VoicePill.@stop: Listening ended. Reason is release, tap, key, escape, blur, cancel, disabled, mic-denied or unmount; duration in ms.

WakeSlider.@change: Called on every committed change, from the pointer or the keyboard.
WakeSlider.step: Snapping grid. Large steps move the handle in notches, and the wake pulses per notch.
WakeSlider.bars: How many bars draw the track.
WakeSlider.height: Full bar height in pixels, the ceiling of the wake.
WakeSlider.restHeight: Bar height at rest in pixels.
WakeSlider.fillColor: Lit bars, up to the value.
WakeSlider.crestColor: Optional tint the raised bars take on by their lift. Empty renders no tint layer.
WakeSlider.sensitivity: How easily speed raises the wake. Low needs a flick; high lifts it on a stroll.
WakeSlider.reach: Half-width of the wake at full speed, in bars.
WakeSlider.skew: How much wider the wake is behind the handle than ahead. 0 is symmetric.
WakeSlider.glide: Seconds the handle takes to settle. Short hugs the finger; long floats behind it.
WakeSlider.smoothing: Milliseconds of velocity lag. Low twitches with every change of speed; high lingers.
WakeSlider.showValue: Shows the value beside the track.
WakeSlider.formatValue: Formats the readout and the announced value.
WakeSlider.disabled: Fades the slider and ignores input.

WarmTooltip.content: The label. Keep it to a few words.
WarmTooltip.shortcut: Optional keyboard shortcut, drawn as a keycap beside the label.
WarmTooltip.default slot: The trigger. Bind the slot prop describedby to its aria-describedby; its own handlers and focus ring stay untouched.
WarmTooltip.side: The edge the label hangs from; also where the fuse runs and the pop originates.
WarmTooltip.delay: How long a cold open waits, in milliseconds. Inherits the group value when omitted.
WarmTooltip.warmWindow: How long after this label closes the group stays warm. Inherits the group value when omitted.
WarmTooltip.inkColor: Label text; the keycap is tinted from it.
WarmTooltip.size: Font size and padding of the label.
WarmTooltip.radius: Corner radius of the label in pixels.
WarmTooltip.gap: Distance between the trigger edge and the label.
WarmTooltip.arrow: Shows the pointer on the anchored edge.
WarmTooltip.popDuration: Cold pop-in time in milliseconds; the exit takes 0.8 of it.
WarmTooltip.popScale: Scale the label pops from. 1 makes it a fade.
WarmTooltip.popBlur: Blur in pixels the label arrives through.
WarmTooltip.showFuse: Draws a thin line along the trigger edge that fills over the delay, or over the long press on touch.
WarmTooltip.longPress: Hold time in milliseconds that opens the label on touch; the click that follows is swallowed.
WarmTooltip.disabled: No open path; an open label closes.
WarmTooltip.className: Extra classes for the trigger wrapper.
WarmTooltip.WarmTooltipGroup: Wraps a toolbar so its tooltips share one label. Props: delay (400), warmWindow (300), travel (320, how long the label takes to glide to the next trigger; 0 hops), lean (0, degrees of tilt while gliding), {'@'}warmChange. Exposes reset().

DepthText.text: The word or short phrase rendered as extruded type.
DepthText.layers: Number of stacked copies that form the extrusion. Clamped to protect the DOM.
DepthText.depth: Spacing in pixels between each layer of the extrusion.
DepthText.faceColor: Color of the crisp front face of the text.
DepthText.depthColor: Tint used for the back of the extrusion and its shadow.
DepthText.pointerTracking: Enables smoothed pointer parallax on fine pointer devices.
DepthText.smoothing: Damping amount used to ease rotation toward the pointer target.
DepthText.perspective: Perspective distance in pixels for the 3D stack.
DepthText.autoOrbit: Adds a subtle orbit when pointer tracking is unavailable or idle.
DepthText.orbitSpeed: Speed of the fallback orbit in cycles per second.
DepthText.fontSize: CSS font-size value for the display word.
DepthText.fontWeight: Font weight used for every layer.
DepthText.shadow: Adds a soft colored drop shadow to the front face.
DepthText.className: Optional class name for the outer wrapper.
DepthText.style: Optional inline styles for the outer wrapper.

EchoText.text: Text rendered by the crisp front copy and every echo layer.
EchoText.echoes: Number of ghost copies behind the front text.
EchoText.lag: How slowly deeper echoes chase the current target.
EchoText.offset: Pixel travel used by the entrance spread and pointer response.
EchoText.direction: Direction the entrance trail collapses from.
EchoText.fade: Opacity falloff applied from one echo to the next.
EchoText.blur: Maximum blur in pixels on the deepest echo.
EchoText.tint: Optional chromatic tint blended into the echo layers.
EchoText.mode: Whether to run the entrance, pointer smear, or both.
EchoText.cursorRadius: Distance in pixels over which the cursor pulls the text to full offset. Larger values react from further away and arrive later.
EchoText.ease: Timing curve used for the entrance convergence.
EchoText.fontSize: Font size applied to the text stack.
EchoText.fontWeight: Font weight applied to all copies.
EchoText.color: Color of the crisp front copy.
EchoText.className: Additional class names for the root element.
EchoText.style: Optional inline styles for the root element.

FoldText.text: The text content to split and fold into place.
FoldText.splitBy: Controls whether each character, word, or explicit line folds as a panel.
FoldText.hinge: The edge that acts as the 3D fold hinge.
FoldText.duration: Duration in seconds for each panel to unfold.
FoldText.stagger: Delay in seconds between panels; 0.03-0.08 keeps the cascade crisp.
FoldText.ease: GSAP easing curve used by the unfold timeline.
FoldText.perspective: Perspective distance applied to each panel parent.
FoldText.creaseShading: Strength of the gradient shade while panels are folded.
FoldText.trigger: Determines when the unfold animation starts.
FoldText.fontSize: Font size applied to the root text.
FoldText.fontWeight: Font weight applied to the root text.
FoldText.color: Text color of the folded panels.
FoldText.className: Adds custom classes to the root element.
FoldText.style: Inline style overrides for the root element.

MaskedHeading.tag: Element the heading renders as, so it can carry the right semantics.
MaskedHeading.mediaType: Whether the source showing through the letters is an image or a looping muted video.
MaskedHeading.poster: Poster frame used while a video loads.
MaskedHeading.fillScale: How far the media is zoomed past the heading. The overscan is what parallax travels into.
MaskedHeading.parallax: How far the media slides under the letters as the pointer moves, in px.
MaskedHeading.drift: Amplitude of the slow idle motion, in px. 0 holds the media still.
MaskedHeading.grayscale: Render the media in black and white.
MaskedHeading.reveal: Entrance style: words rise into place, a wipe sweeps across, or the whole block fades up.
MaskedHeading.stagger: Delay between words, in seconds. Used by the rise reveal.
MaskedHeading.textScale: Type size as a fraction of the container width, so the heading stays responsive.

ParticleText.text: The words sampled into particle targets.
ParticleText.particleSize: Rendered size of each particle in CSS pixels.
ParticleText.density: Pixel sampling step for the offscreen glyph canvas. Lower values create more particles.
ParticleText.highlightColor: Secondary color blended through the particle field.
ParticleText.scatter: How far particles begin from their final glyph targets.
ParticleText.gatherDuration: Milliseconds for particles to converge into the text.
ParticleText.stagger: Maximum per-particle delay in milliseconds before gathering.
ParticleText.idleDrift: Subtle resting motion after the text has formed.
ParticleText.trigger: How the scatter-and-reform sequence can replay after the first formation.
ParticleText.fontSize: Canvas text size used for glyph sampling.
ParticleText.fontFamily: Font family used for sampling. Inherit waits for the surrounding font before sampling.
ParticleText.glow: Adds a soft particle bloom in the highlight color.
ParticleText.style: Optional inline styles for the wrapper.

SplitFlapText.words: Phrases to cycle through like a departure board.
SplitFlapText.text: Optional single phrase. When set, it takes precedence over words.
SplitFlapText.flipDuration: Duration, in seconds, of each individual flap turn.
SplitFlapText.stagger: Delay, in seconds, between each tile starting its cascade.
SplitFlapText.cycleDelay: Hold time, in milliseconds, before cycling to the next phrase.
SplitFlapText.charset: Characters used for the intermediate flip glyphs.
SplitFlapText.flipsPerChar: Number of intermediate glyphs each changed tile flips through.
SplitFlapText.tileColor: Base color of each mechanical tile.
SplitFlapText.textColor: Color of the glyphs on every flap.
SplitFlapText.fontSize: Tile type size. Numeric values are treated as pixels.
SplitFlapText.loop: Whether the phrase array repeats after the final phrase.
SplitFlapText.padTo: Fixed tile count used to keep the board width stable.
SplitFlapText.className: Optional class name for custom styling.
SplitFlapText.style: Optional inline styles for the root element.

StrokeText.text: The heading copy rendered as measured SVG glyphs.
StrokeText.strokeColor: Color used for the drawing outline.
StrokeText.fillColor: Color that floods into the glyphs after the outline draw.
StrokeText.strokeWidth: Width of the SVG text outline.
StrokeText.drawDuration: Seconds each character outline spends drawing on.
StrokeText.fillDelay: Seconds to wait after the outline draw before the fill begins.
StrokeText.stagger: Delay in seconds between each character animation.
StrokeText.ease: GSAP easing used for the outline draw.
StrokeText.trigger: Chooses when the draw timeline starts.
StrokeText.fillMode: Controls whether fill appears with a fade, left-to-right wipe, or not at all.
StrokeText.fontSize: SVG font size before the responsive viewBox scales the wordmark.
StrokeText.letterSpacing: Tracking applied during measurement and rendering.
StrokeText.reverse: Draws the stagger from the final character back to the first.
StrokeText.className: Optional class applied to the root wrapper.
StrokeText.style: Inline styles passed to the root wrapper.

TextLoop.text: The phrase repeated along the curve.
TextLoop.shape: Built-in curve the text flows along.
TextLoop.path: Custom SVG path data, drawn in a 1200x400 viewBox. Overrides shape when provided.
TextLoop.speed: Travel speed along the path, in units per second.
TextLoop.direction: Direction the text scrolls around the curve.
TextLoop.curviness: Amplitude of the wave, or the radius of the closed shapes.
TextLoop.fontSize: Font size of the looping text.
TextLoop.fontWeight: Font weight of the looping text.
TextLoop.ribbon: Draws a solid band behind the text along the path.
TextLoop.ribbonColor: Color of the band behind the text.
TextLoop.ribbonWidth: Thickness of the band behind the text.
TextLoop.pauseOnHover: Pauses the loop while the pointer is over it.
TextLoop.className: Additional CSS classes for the wrapper.

WarpText.text: The headline text rendered into the WebGL texture.
WarpText.color: Text fill color before the glass refraction pass.
WarpText.warpStrength: Amount of ambient glass distortion at rest.
WarpText.warpScale: Size of the moving distortion cells.
WarpText.pointerInfluence: Radius of the cursor lensing area.
WarpText.pointerStrength: Strength of cursor-driven bending and magnification.
WarpText.refraction: Subtle RGB channel split for the glass edge.
WarpText.ripple: Adds a soft ripple to the pointer lens.
WarpText.fontSize: Canvas raster font size. Numbers are pixels.
WarpText.fontWeight: Font weight used when rasterising the text texture.
WarpText.fontFamily: Font family used when rasterising the text texture.
WarpText.letterSpacing: Tracking applied while drawing the text into the texture.
WarpText.className: Optional class name for the root element.
WarpText.style: Optional inline styles for sizing or layout.

introduction.about: Vue Bits is an open-source collection of expressive UI components for adding motion and personality without adopting an entire design system.

mission.title: Mission
mission.goal: The goal of Vue Bits is simple - provide flexible, visually stunning and most importantly, free components that take Vue projects to the next level.
mission.principlesIntro: To make that happen, the project is committed to the following principles:

freeForAll.label: Free For All
freeForAll.text: {label}: You own the code, and it's free to use in your projects

propFirst.label: Prop-First Approach
propFirst.text: {label}: Easy customization through thoughtfully exposed props

modular.label: Fully Modular
modular.text: {label}: Install strictly what you need, Vue Bits is not a dependency

stack.label: Single, Consistent Stack
stack.text: {label}: Every component ships as Vue 3 + TypeScript, styled with Tailwind, so it drops straight into a modern Vue app

freeForAll.title: Free For All
freeForAll.body: Every component you choose to bring into your project is yours to modify or extend, because you get full visibility of the code, not just an import.

propFirst.title: Prop-First Approach
propFirst.body: Every component is designed to be flexible and customizable, with props that let you adjust the look and feel without always having to dive into the code.

modular.title: Fully Modular
modular.body: Vue Bits is not your classic NPM library, you install only the components you need by either copying the code or using the CLI, without pulling in a whole library.

stack.title: Single, Consistent Stack
stack.body: Every component is written in TypeScript and styled with Tailwind CSS, so there's exactly one version to reach for - no picking between JS/TS or CSS/Tailwind variants.

performance.title: Performance
performance.intro: While we do everything possible to optimize components and offer the best experience, here are some tips to keep in mind when using Vue Bits:

lessIsMore.label: Less Is More
lessIsMore.text: {label}: Using more than 2-3 components on a page is not advised, it can overload your page with animations, potentially impacting performance or UX

mobile.label: Mobile Optimization
mobile.text: {label}: Consider disabling certain effects on mobile and replacing them with static placeholders instead

thoroughTesting.label: Test Thoroughly
thoroughTesting.text: {label}: Your device may be high-end, but be considerate of your users - always test on multiple devices before going live
